Greenhouse: Databricks:8860667002.description: MKTQ427R50 As the Director of Technical Marketing at Databricks, you will lead and scale the team responsible for explaining Databricks products, and what you can do with them, at scale to technical buyers and practitioners (from data engineers, data scientists, and ML engineers to solutions architects, platform teams, security engineers, and application developers). You will own the strategy and execution of technical content in written and video form, demos, workshops, launch storytelling, and outbound evangelism that drives technical mindshare, consideration, product adoption, and ultimately pipeline. In the era of agentic marketing and AEO/GEO, your team will increasingly produce content designed to educate both humans and agents alike. You will also play an outsized role in programming the technical content for key Databricks events, such as the Data + AI Summit and Data + AI World Tour, among others. Reporting to the SVP of Product & Solutions Marketing, you will manage a team of 6+ Technical Marketing Managers (growing) and serve as the connective tissue between Product, Product Marketing, Field Engineering, and the broader technical community. This role expands the traditional TMM charter to include a stronger outbound evangelism dimension, becoming a visible, trusted technical voice externally through social media, YouTube, conferences, and the data practitioner ecosystem while continuing to own the core technical content engine that powers Summit, World Tour, workshops, and field enablement. The impact you will have: First 6 months: Assess the current TMM team's strengths, gaps, and capacity; establish a clear operating model with defined ownership areas (product coverage, content types, GEO) and a quarterly planning cadence. Own and deliver the technical content agenda for Data + AI World Tour and/or the next major Tier 1 event, achieving ≥4.5/5.0 average session ratings and measurable pipeline contribution. Launch or significantly expand at least 2 new outbound evangelism motions (e.g., a YouTube series architecture, a technical social media cadence, or a creator/influencer engagement program) that grow Databricks' external technical reach by ≥25%. Build an AI-powered publishing engine that enables the TMM team to scale content faster, leveraging AI assistance for content creation and publishing. Establish yourself as a credible external technical voice, publishing 3+ original technical pieces (blogs, videos, or talks) and representing Databricks at 2+ external events or podcasts. First 12 months: Scale the TMM team to meet growing demand across an expanding set of technical personas (solutions architects, platform engineers, security teams, data scientists, analysts, app developers) driven by the 2026+ product surface (Lakebase, Genie, Lakewatch, Agent Bricks, Omnigent). Work with Databricks Field Engineering and FDE (Forward-Deployed Engineering) to capture repeatable product use cases into a Solutions Library, building a motion to scale capture and marketing of these use cases for learning across the entire community. Build and operationalize a "1 launch → many assets" content engine that converts every major product launch into persona-specific learning journeys (demos, workshops, blogs, videos, social). Grow Databricks' YouTube and social technical content reach by 2x, with a series-based content architecture targeting key personas at multiple depth levels. Drive measurable contribution to AEO/GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) ensuring Databricks is cited by default in AI answer engines for key buyer questions. First 18–24 months: Establish Databricks as the default place every technical practitioner learns data + AI, measured by YouTube subscriber growth (target: 300K+), technical content engagement, and Free Edition activation rates tied to content. Build a formal Databricks Creators program that turns independent creator reach into co-owned, accurate, early-access content across new product areas. Develop the TMM team into a recognized center of excellence — with clear career paths, a strong hiring bar, and a reputation as one of the best technical marketing teams in enterprise software. What we look for: 10+ years of experience in technical marketing, developer relations, solutions engineering, field engineering, or a related technical field in enterprise software / SaaS / cloud. 3+ years of people management experience, with a track record of hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing technical teams. Deep technical fluency in data, AI/ML, and cloud platforms, comfortable building demos and engaging credibly with data engineers, data scientists, solutions architects, and other technical practitioners across the data + AI ecosystem. Demonstrated outbound evangelism skills, including a visible external presence through conference speaking, technical blogging, YouTube/video content, or social media thought leadership. Experience owning technical content strategy for major product launches and flagship events (e.g., user conferences, world tours). Strong cross-functional influence with a proven ability to partner with Product Management, Product Marketing, Field Engineering, and Sales to align on priorities and deliver integrated GTM. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into compelling narratives for multiple audiences. Preferred: Experience with data platforms, lakehouse architectures, Apache Spark, or related open-source data technologies. Greenhouse: Databricks:8638642002.title: Director, Web Marketing
Greenhouse: Databricks:8638642002.description: MKTQ327R30 Databricks is hiring an experienced web leader to grow and scale the function globally, as the company continues its hyper-growth and leadership in the Data and AI space. You will be an essential member of the marketing leadership team, drawing on all of our internal resources to bring our marketing strategy to our digital audiences — and increasingly to a new kind of audience: the AI agents and assistants that now read, interpret, and act on the web on behalf of the people we're trying to reach. You will ultimately be measured on your ability to develop a cohesive portfolio of web properties built for scale, personalization, and this next era of how people and machines discover and evaluate companies. Reporting to the VP of Marketing, you will build and oversee a product team focused on executing and iterating on marketing priorities. The ideal candidate has held a senior digital leadership role in a high-performing marketing organization at a company experiencing rapid growth. You have operated at scale in a global environment while maintaining a solution-oriented mindset and approach. You have excellent fundamentals, strong presence, and the ability to build a strong team. Just as important, you have a point of view on where the web is going, and know how to build for AI-driven search, answer engines, and autonomous agents. The impact you will have: Transform Databricks' web properties into outstanding destinations using a modern development approach and current technologies, built to serve both human visitors and the AI agents and assistants that now consume and act on web content. Put AI to work inside the function, using it to automate and accelerate web production, QA, localization, testing, and routine optimization so the team spends its time on strategy and craft rather than repetitive execution. Establish a strategy for how Databricks evolves and scales its web presence with the business across segments, products, industries, partners, and languages — and for how our content stays legible, accurate, and well-represented as AI systems increasingly mediate discovery. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. We are the UI Platform team, responsible for enabling all frontend developers at Databricks to build amazing features. We support hundreds of developers working in the frontend every week, making sure that they can use AI tooling to build features, can quickly ship them to production, and have best-in class monitoring and observability of what they build.. We own all aspects of the dev loop, relying on industry-standard technology like Typescript, React, GraphQL, yarn, node and more! We're seeking a dedicated Engineering Leader for our Developer Experience team. This team is responsible for the entire life cycle of a feature: dev loop, submitting, pushing, monitoring… everything needed to ensure smooth delivery of code from the developer’s head to production! You will report directly to the Senior Manager of Engineering. The main responsibilities include: You will lead a talented engineering team in UI Platform focused on making our frontend developer experience amazing. You will oversee sustained recruitment of top-tier talent, and developing talent on the team. You will build processes to implement product vision and strategy, according to organizational goals and priorities. You will build software that is not just high quality, but easy to operate. You will manage technical debt, including long-term technical architecture decisions, and balance product roadmap. What we look for: 5+ years of hands-on experience in web frontend development, with a strong preference for React-based applications 2+ years leading and managing a high-performing engineering team. A passion for infrastructure, tooling, developer productivity, or performance optimization and the ability to drive technical initiatives that improve overall team efficiency and code quality Demonstrated ability to mentor, coach, and develop engineering talent at various levels Ability to drive technical initiatives that improve overall team efficiency and code quality Experience in setting and achieving ambitious team goals aligned with company objectives Strong track record of attracting, hiring, and retaining top engineering talent Experience managing distributed teams across multiple locations. Adaptability and resilience in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving tech environment Pay Range Transparency Databricks is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Greenhouse: Databricks:8842408002.description: SLSQ427R685 Databricks is looking for an Enterprise Account Executive (Energy & Utilities) to join us in Sydney, Australia. This role is designed as a Named Core role and reports to the Director of Enterprise Sales. As a Named Core Account Executive, you are pivotal in driving the company's growth by expanding our footprint and driving the consumption of Databricks' services with existing customers. You will drive business transformation for some of the region's most prominent enterprise organisations in the Energy & Utilities sector. You will be operating in an industry undergoing immense transition—driven by grid modernisation, renewable integration, decarbonisation, and smart metering—and will help connect customers' strategic priorities to the power of the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. The Impact You Will Have: In this role, you will lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from discovery through execution and consumption growth. Operating as the "quarterback" of your account teams, you will orchestrate internal resources, hyperscaler partners (AWS, Azure, GCP), and system integrators to deliver high-impact business outcomes. Driving Consumption: Help customers derive value from the platform by identifying key use cases and increasing usage. Securing Strategic Committed Deals: Identify, structure and close opportunities to co-invest in high-priority initiatives to accelerate and de-risk projects delivery Prospecting and Lead Generation: Use various strategies and resources, such as intent signals, account planning, and leveraging customer stories, to effectively prospect and target leads. Prospect Engagement: Leverage BDRs, Marketing and Network to build relationships with key prospects in territory to displace incumbent technologies. Sales Execution: Conduct first meetings with compelling POVs to create urgency for change. Create territory and account plans to prioritise pursuits. Engage in activities such as roundtables, bootcamps and industry events to build relationships and progress pipeline. Pipeline Management: Maintain an accurate and updated Salesforce (SF) pipeline, create proof of concepts (POCs), and manage the sales cycle from initial contact to closing the deal. Collaboration: Engage with architects, professional services engagement managers coordinate demand planning sessions, and align with executive sponsors to ensure a comprehensive approach to customer success. What We Look For: Characteristics: Takes initiative, is proactive and drives. Unwavering Prioritisation & Grit. Detail-oriented. Creative Coachability Open to Change and uncertainty Experience: Proven track record in sales. Demonstrable experience in selling innovation, ideally in Big Data, Cloud, or SaaS technology in a consumption-first world. Experience selling to Energy & Utilities accounts is highly desirable. Skills: Strong prospecting, lead generation, and customer engagement skills. Ability to drive consumption and secure first-time commits. Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including GDRs and Customer Success teams. Technical Acumen: Understanding of Databricks' platform and the ability to communicate its value to customers. About Databricks Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Greenhouse: Databricks:8641466002.description: Field Marketing Manager, Mexico MKTQ127R3 As the Field Marketing Manager for Mexico, you will be the strategic bridge between marketing and sales for one of Databricks’ fastest-growing markets in LATAM. You will own how marketing translates into pipeline and revenue for Mexico—turning customer insights, sales priorities, and global programs into local, full-funnel demand. Reporting to the Director of Americas Field Marketing, you will be accountable for building a predictable, data-driven field marketing engine that accelerates sales success in the region. Impact Statement (What success looks like in 12–24 months) Consistently meet or exceed agreed marketing-sourced pipeline and revenue contribution targets for the Mexico business, with clear accountability for lead-to-opportunity and opportunity-to-close conversion. Greenhouse: Databricks:8688875002.description: GAQ327R292 We're building a finance function that stays ahead of the curve - leveraging AI, automation, and modern tooling to operate at the pace Databricks demands. We are looking for two Consolidations Managers to join our Global Accounting team based in India. These are foundational hires - you will own the end-to-end consolidation and intercompany accounting process across Databricks' 23-entity global footprint, build deep SAP Group Reporting expertise during our S/4HANA implementation, and establish the permanent organisational capability that scales with the business post go-live. This role blends hands-on consolidation execution with technical accounting judgment. As part of the Global Accounting organisation, you will ensure the accurate and timely production of consolidated financial statements under both US GAAP and IFRS, while partnering closely with International Accounting, Corporate Accounting, Tax, and FP&A to drive close integrity across all reporting frameworks. The impact you will have: Own and execute the global consolidation process end-to-end - intercompany reconciliation, elimination entries, currency translation, and multi-entity roll-up across our 23-entity footprint. Lead multi-GAAP close execution, producing parallel US GAAP and IFRS consolidated books each period, identifying and documenting reconciling differences for audit and leadership review. Build and own SAP Group Reporting expertise - serve as the accounting team's subject matter expert on SAP's consolidation engine, including configuration, period-end processing, and ongoing optimisation. Execute intercompany accounting across all entities - ensuring balances are reconciled, disputes are resolved within the close window, and elimination entries are complete and accurate. Perform monthly consolidation flux analysis, identifying and clearly articulating drivers behind significant period-over-period movements for leadership and cross-functional stakeholders. Own FX translation and revaluation accounting - functional currency determination, translation adjustments, and CTA reconciliation across all international entities. Support new entity stand-up - partner with Tax, Legal, and International Accounting to establish consolidation processes, intercompany agreements, and reporting structures for new international selling entities as Databricks expands. Serve as a primary point of contact for internal and external audit on consolidation, intercompany, and multi-GAAP reporting matters. Champion compliance with SOX controls across the consolidation process. Drive AI and automation adoption across consolidation workflows - including automated intercompany matching, elimination entry generation, and reconciliation tooling leveraging the Databricks platform. Partner with the Senior Manager, Close & Consolidation (US) to ensure seamless handoff and time-zone coverage for the most time-sensitive part of the global close. What we look for: BA/BS Degree with a focus in Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, or Finance. 10+ years progressive accounting experience, with at least 5+ years specifically in consolidation, intercompany accounting, or international accounting within a US multinational framework. A Chartered Accountant (CA) or CPA equivalent certification is mandatory. Deep understanding of US GAAP consolidation requirements (ASC 810, ASC 830) and working knowledge of IFRS consolidation standards (IFRS 10, IAS 21). Multi-GAAP reporting experience is strongly preferred. SAP S/4HANA experience required - specifically SAP Group Reporting or SAP BPC. Candidates with implementation experience will be prioritized. Proven experience managing intercompany accounting at scale - reconciliation, netting, dispute resolution, and elimination across a multi-entity, multi-currency environment. Experience with FX translation, functional currency assessment, and CTA accounting across complex international structures. Proven track record driving automation and process improvement in consolidation or close operations. Experience supporting external audits and SOX compliance in a consolidation context. Proven experience partnering with remote teams across different geographic areas, including with US-based accounting leadership, and the flexibility to support close timelines that span US Pacific Time hours. Establish key metrics (NPS or similar, participation rates, cost-per-attendee) to measure event impact, connection, and inform future programming. Deep experience in event production, including technical/AV integration, spatial planning, and high-touch VIP white-glove service. Greenhouse: Databricks:8824179002.description: FEQ427R548 The Impact You Will Have The pace of Data and AI is outrunning how most teams enable their field. Databricks ships at the edge of innovation, new products, frontier AI, deeper alliances, faster than any seller can absorb. The problem? Innovation the field can't explain simply doesn't drive adoption. In this role, you'll build the strategy, plan, process, and engine that turn our fast-moving products and GTM alliances into enablement that drives revenue, making the complex simple. At Databricks, we're all builders. On the Global Sales Enablement team, partnering across Product, Marketing, GTM, Alliances, and the field, you'll put our newest products and partnerships into sellers' hands while they're still an edge over the competition. This is an individual-contributor role, you lead through cross-functional influence and what you build. What You'll Do Own the strategy, plan, process, and enablement engine, from onboarding through competitive readiness, over a 6 to 12 month horizon. Design the programs and sales plays that drive revenue, not just readiness: tie every motion to pipeline, consumption, and win rate, and choose the right motion for each goal. Turn our product priorities into field-ready enablement fast: positioning, demos, competitive readiness, and deal support, live within days of a launch. Enable the field to sell with and through our go-to-market partnerships and strategic alliances: co-sell plays, joint value props, and the partnership context that shapes a deal. Build and deliver at scale: AI pipelines, vibe coding, and automation for first drafts you curate for impact, plus the LMS and sales tooling to distribute, lift productivity, and track performance. Set the operating rhythm, cadence, metrics, and reviews, that others adopt, and keep a tight loop with the field and SMEs so friction and lost-deal patterns feed straight back into what you build. What Success Looks Like Within 6 to 12 months, the field is ready before every major launch or motion goes live, not a quarter after, measured by launch readiness and certification attainment across your target sales population. Your enablement moves the numbers that matter: more qualified use cases created, higher consumption, and measurable influence on deal velocity and win rate in competitive situations. Sellers actually use what you build. Adoption of your assets is high and rising, and reps reach for them in live customer conversations. Sales leaders treat you as their go-to enablement partner, and the operating rigor you instill becomes the standard beyond your own programs. Enablement stops being overhead and becomes a revenue lever the field can't sell without. What We Look For 7+ years in sales enablement, product marketing, or a GTM or alliances role for a technical data, AI, or cloud platform, with sharp instincts for what high-quality, revenue-driving enablement looks like. Deep fluency across data, AI, and the frontier-model landscape, with a gift for making complex technical concepts land for sellers. A fully hands-on, AI-native builder who personally builds and ships content, skills, apps, and processes with AI, and leads high-impact programs across motions and seller roles at scale without losing depth. Demonstrated expertise across multiple sales methodologies and the credibility to advise sales leaders on applying them. Exceptional cross-functional stakeholder management, with the EQ and exec presence to influence Directors and Senior Directors as a trusted advisor. A bias for action: you pilot fast, read the results, and iterate. Sound judgment in ambiguous, multi-priority situations, and you elevate the Culture Principles beyond your own work, helping others apply them at scale and through trade-offs. Nice to Have Value-selling methodology certification (Force Management / Command of the Message). Direct experience enabling a strategic alliance or cloud co-sell motion, and knowledge of how co-sell shapes enterprise deals. Experience at a high-growth data or AI infrastructure company during a major product launch. Experience building enablement or internal tools with AI (content pipelines, agents, AI role-plays). You will be responsible for building and managing a highly technical enterprise engineering team, developing first principled-based strategies, and enabling strong enterprise security. Key responsibilities include engineering, securing and optimizing cloud infrastructure, Identity and Access Management, Endpoints, Collaboration tools, and ensuring compliance with SOX, PCI DSS, and FedRAMP compliance. The Head of Corporate Engineering will work closely with R&D on managing engineering tools like Jira, Confluence, and GitHub, driving efficient adoption and integration. Strong technical and influencing leadership principles coupled with the ability to manage a complex, scaling, and fast-moving enterprise environment are essential. This role reports directly to the Vice President, Infrastructure and Operations Responsibilities: In this influential role, you will be responsible for: Securing the Enterprise: Working closely with Enterprise Security organization to harden and secure our cloud environments, secret management, collaboration tools, endpoints, SaaS environments, IAM tools, and more. Enforce security policies, configure & manage security settings and ensure compliance across all endpoints and mobile devices. Success is measured in terms of end-user satisfaction and % of manual touch. Collaboration Management : Ensure we provide world class tools to our employees to be extremely productive and collaborative. This would include but not be limited to managing and scaling internal workplace products like Gmail, Slack, Atlassian, Moveworks, Glean, and more. Included are both internal and external identity providers to be managed. Success is measured by compliance, Identity governance, and availability Desired Success Outcomes A high-performing enterprise engineering team capable of handling complex technical projects with agility and high quality. Well defined cloud strategy ensuring the stability, scalability, and security of cloud infrastructure. Overhaul of current processes and workflows to address inefficiencies and increase team velocity. Robust endpoint security with Implementation of comprehensive security measures for all endpoints, including Mac, Windows, and mobile devices. Deliver high-quality employee experience with productivity tools (Gmail, Slack, Atlassian tools, Moveworks, GitHub) with a robust forward-looking roadmap. Efficient operational support for Tier 3 IT services with minimized production incidents. Implementation of robust incident and change management processes with mature operational practice Efficient and mature processes for system integrations related to Mergers and Acquisitions (M&As), ensuring timely smooth transitions during M&A integrations. Development and implementation of automation tools and frameworks, Identification of automation opportunities to reduce manual toil and improve accuracy. Qualifications: 10 years of experience managing Cloud infrastructure at large enterprises. Extensive experience managing public cloud implementations in AWS. Experience with GCP and Azure will be a plus. In-depth understanding of Cloud native technologies to lead and guide the team. Continuously identify opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness through data, automation, and AI. Greenhouse: Databricks:8571578002.description: SLSQ327R320 Databricks is seeking a Lakebase Associate Director to help customers modernize their operational data foundation with Databricks Lakebase, our fully-managed Postgres offering for intelligent applications. This high-impact role sits within the Lakebase Go-To-Market team and partners closely with Industry Account Executives within our Financial Services vertical to drive adoption of Lakebase with platform, application, and data teams. Lakebase gives customers a unified, governed foundation for operational workloads and AI-native applications, helping them move away from a fragmented estate of point databases toward a modern, scalable, serverless Postgres service. If you want to be at the forefront of operational databases for AI and intelligent applications at one of the fastest-growing data and AI companies in the world, this is your opportunity. The impact you will have Drive new Lakebase revenue by identifying, qualifying, and driving Lakebase activations and consumption within a defined territory, in partnership with regional Account Executives and the broader account team. Lead with outcomes for key Lakebase personas — including platform teams and developers, data teams, and central IT — articulating how Lakebase helps them ship features faster, simplify operational data architectures, and improve governance and cost efficiency. Sell the value of fully-managed Postgres for intelligent applications, positioning Lakebase as the optimal choice for operational workloads that power real-time, AI-driven experiences. Orchestrate proof-of-value and POCs that validate Lakebase’s benefits for OLTP-style workloads, reverse ETL, and AI/ML-driven applications, in partnership with solution architects and specialists. Field, account, & customer enablement: Align customers and the field on the value of Lakebase by equipping AEs and SAs with the messaging and execution motions needed to confidently own accounts without specialist intervention. Proven success selling data platforms, operational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, cloud-native DBaaS), or adjacent data/AI infrastructure to technical buyers and business leaders. Strong understanding of modern data and application architectures, including cloud-native services, microservices, event-driven systems, and how operational data underpins AI and analytics strategies. Ability to sell to both technical stakeholders (developers, architects, data engineers) and business stakeholders (product leaders, operations, line-of-business owners). Demonstrated experience leading specialist or overlay motions, working jointly with core Account Executives to create and progress opportunities. Executive presence with the ability to whiteboard architectures, lead C-level conversations, and build trust with senior decision makers. Strong value selling skills: adept at discovering pain, building a business case, and tying technical capabilities to clear, quantified outcomes. Excellent communication, storytelling, and negotiation skills, with comfort presenting to both large and small audiences. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. Preferred qualifications Experience selling Postgres, operational databases, OLTP workloads, or transactional cloud database services, ideally within large or strategic accounts. Familiarity with data platforms, Lakehouse architectures, and cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP), including how operational databases fit within broader data and AI strategies. Understanding of reverse ETL, real-time decisioning, and operational analytics use cases, and how they drive value for customer-facing and internal applications. This high-impact role sits within the Lakebase Go-To-Market team and partners closely with regional Account Executives within our Retail vertical to drive adoption of Lakebase with platform, application, and data teams. Lakebase gives customers a unified, governed foundation for operational workloads and AI-native applications, helping them move away from a fragmented estate of point databases toward a modern, scalable, serverless Postgres service. If you want to be at the forefront of operational databases for AI and intelligent applications at one of the fastest-growing data and AI companies in the world, this is your opportunity. The impact you will have Drive new Lakebase revenue by identifying, qualifying, and driving Lakebase activations and consumption within a defined territory, in partnership with regional Account Executives and the broader account team. Lead with outcomes for key Lakebase personas — including platform teams and developers, data teams, and central IT — articulating how Lakebase helps them ship features faster, simplify operational data architectures, and improve governance and cost efficiency. Sell the value of fully-managed Postgres for intelligent applications, positioning Lakebase as the optimal choice for operational workloads that power real-time, AI-driven experiences. Run complex, multi-threaded sales cycles from discovery and value hypothesis through commercial negotiation and close, navigating executive, technical, and line-of-business stakeholders. Orchestrate proof-of-value and POCs that validate Lakebase’s benefits for OLTP-style workloads, reverse ETL, and AI/ML-driven applications, in partnership with solution architects and specialists. Compete and win against legacy and cloud-native operational databases by leveraging our compete assets, benchmarks, and customer references. Align to measurable business outcomes such as performance, developer productivity, time-to-market for new features, cost reduction, and simplification of the operational data landscape. Partner cross-functionally with Product Management, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partner teams to shape territory plans, launch plays, and co-selling motions with key ISVs and GSIs. Enable the field by sharing Lakebase best practices, success stories, and sales motions with broader sales teams, helping scale Lakebase proficiency across the organization. What success looks like in this role This role requires the ability to operate across two key motions simultaneously: Establish top strategic focus accounts by engaging application development teams to create net-new intelligent applications leveraging Lakebase. Drive longer-term Postgres standardization and migration within Databricks' most strategic accounts. Candidates should demonstrate how they can act as a force multiplier across multiple dimensions of the business. Success in this role requires strength in four areas: Business ownership – Operate at a business-unit level by tracking revenue, pipeline, and key observations, and by identifying areas needing additional focus or support. Strategic account engagement – Partner with account teams to engage priority accounts across the global DB700, driving strategic opportunities from initial engagement through successful outcomes. Field, account, & customer enablement: Align customers and the field on the value of Lakebase by equipping AEs and SAs with the messaging and execution motions needed to confidently own accounts without specialist intervention. Market voice and thought leadership – Develop an internal and external presence by contributing to global AMAs and internal forums, and by representing Databricks at key first- and third-party events. The interview process is designed to evaluate candidates across all four of these dimensions. What we look for 7+ years of enterprise SaaS sales experience, consistently exceeding quota in complex, multi-stakeholder deals. Proven success selling data platforms, operational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, cloud-native DBaaS), or adjacent data/AI infrastructure to technical buyers and business leaders. Strong understanding of modern data and application architectures, including cloud-native services, microservices, event-driven systems, and how operational data underpins AI and analytics strategies. Ability to sell to both technical stakeholders (developers, architects, data engineers) and business stakeholders (product leaders, operations, line-of-business owners). Demonstrated experience leading specialist or overlay motions, working jointly with core Account Executives to create and progress opportunities. Executive presence with the ability to whiteboard architectures, lead C-level conversations, and build trust with senior decision makers. Strong value selling skills: adept at discovering pain, building a business case, and tying technical capabilities to clear, quantified outcomes. Excellent communication, storytelling, and negotiation skills, with comfort presenting to both large and small audiences. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. Preferred qualifications Experience selling Postgres, operational databases, OLTP workloads, or transactional cloud database services, ideally within large or strategic accounts. Familiarity with data platforms, lakehouse architectures, and cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP), including how operational databases fit within broader data and AI strategies. Understanding of reverse ETL, real-time decisioning, and operational analytics use cases, and how they drive value for customer-facing and internal applications. Exposure to AI-native and agent-driven applications that depend on low-latency, highly scalable operational data services. Prior experience in a high-growth, category-creating environment, helping shape new plays, messaging, and customer narratives. Experience collaborating with partners and ISVs to drive joint pipeline and co-sell motions. About Databricks Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn , X , YouTube , and Instagram . Benefits At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here . Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics. Greenhouse: Databricks:8780470002.description: CSQ227R10 Role overview We are looking for a Lead Learning Product Specialist to own the platform learning experience for Databricks customers, partners, and internal practitioners. You will sit at the intersection of product, UX, and learning science, building the systems that help data and AI teams build skills needed to become successful and confident users of the Databricks platform. You’ll define how users discover, practice, and demonstrate skills across in-product journeys, training, and AI-assisted guidance. You will work closely with engineering, design, curriculum, and go‑to‑market teams to translate pedagogical goals into scalable platform capabilities, from adaptive learning flows and assessments to analytics that prove real skill development. Key responsibilities Define and drive the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for AI‑first learning systems on the Databricks platform, anchored on contextual,  in the flow of work enablement and a unified skills infrastructure. Design experiences that surface targeted knowledge precisely when users need it, triggered by real work context (e.g., usage patterns, errors, task types), reducing interruptions and friction. Translate learning and pedagogical goals into platform capabilities such as learner models, skills graphs, progress tracking, adaptive learning paths, assessments, and feedback loops. Partner with UX and content design to create intuitive, embedded guidance and learning patterns that feel like part of the workflow, not separate training destinations. Collaborate with platform and infrastructure teams to ensure learning and skills systems are reliable, secure, performant, and able to serve global enterprise customers at scale. Define and evolve predictive signals and analytics that give proactive visibility into emerging skills and capability gaps, enabling action before they impact business outcomes. Build features and tooling that allow enablement teams to deliver at-scale personalization - leveraging AI and automation. Provide employees and leaders with transparent views into skills, enablement activities, and progress toward role and organizational goals through dashboards, reports, and in‑product insights. Work closely with education, documentation, and curriculum teams to empower them with self‑service configuration and experimentation tools for new learning experiences. Engage directly with customers, partners, and internal field teams to deeply understand learning needs across roles and transform these into clear product requirements. What success looks like in the first 12 months A cohesive, AI‑first skills platform and experience is live, guiding users from first login with contextual, just‑in‑time experiences triggered by work context. Clear, trusted metrics exist for learning efficacy and skill attainment and used to drive roadmap decisions. Predictive insights into emerging capability and skills gaps are available to leaders, enabling proactive interventions before they impact business performance. Enablement teams use platform tools you defined to deliver personalized learning and guidance at scale without needing to grow headcount proportionally. Learning and skills capabilities are integrated with broader Databricks platform features and measurably improve adoption and expansion. Qualifications 5–8+ years of experience in product management, UX-focused product roles, or learning/education platforms, ideally within B2B SaaS, developer tools, or data/AI products. Demonstrated experience owning a product area end to end: defining strategy and roadmap, writing PRDs, collaborating with engineering and design, and shipping impactful user-facing features. Experience building or working on learning systems, training platforms, or content/knowledge experiences (LMS, certification, education analytics, in-product guidance, or similar). Strong UX instincts and a track record of collaborating closely with designers and researchers to create intuitive flows, information architectures, and content experiences. Comfort working with data: defining metrics, instrumenting experiments, and using analytics to understand user behavior, learning outcomes, and skills gaps. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to explain complex concepts simply and advocate for learners across the organization. Greenhouse: Databricks:8768956002.description: FEQ427R476 Location: Remote, Germany At Databricks, we build the platform that makes data and AI usable across an entire organization, not just in a specialist team. Our customers come to us with problems that have no template, and the Solutions Architects are the people who work those problems out with them. As a Lead Solutions Architect, you own our most complex enterprise relationships in the region, technically and commercially, and you act as a recognized voice in the wider data community. You will be measured by the impact you have on those accounts and on the Solutions Architects around you. The impact you will have Lead and manage complex enterprise accounts with custom requirements, from the first technical conversation through to production. Deliver compelling demos and pitches to budget holders and C-level stakeholders. Turn customer conversations into working prototypes fast, using AI-assisted development to build demos in hours rather than weeks. Mentor and develop Solutions Architects and Senior SAs together with Field Engineering leadership. Build Databricks' technical presence in the DACH market through customer-facing collateral, workshops, meetups, and conference talks. Develop and roll out best practices and repeatable processes across the region. Establish close working relationships with internal SMEs, product teams, and leadership. What we look for Fluent German and business-level English. Both are used daily with customers and internally. Substantial experience in technical pre-sales, including complex customer interactions across the full sales lifecycle. Ability to drive technical and business conversations with C-level executives, orchestrate cross-functional teams, and influence outcomes toward long-term customer success. Daily, fluent use of AI tools in your own work. Coding assistants and agents are part of how you operate, not something you try out occasionally. Able to vibe-code a demo: assemble a credible, working prototype for a specific customer problem with AI assistance, and recognize where the output still needs your own judgment. Hands-on experience running complex proofs of concept on at least one major public cloud. Judgment to prioritize the right use cases and investments, and to navigate a competitive landscape. Greenhouse: Databricks:8403943002.title: Lead Solutions Architect - Generative AI (EMEA Emerging DNB)
Greenhouse: Databricks:8403943002.description: REQ ID: FEQ227R147 Location: United Kingdom (Remote/Hybrid — London or UK-based) Recruiter: Dina Hussain About the Role We are looking for a Lead Solution Architect focused on Generative AI to support our EMEA Emerging Digital Natives and Startups business unit — one of the fastest-moving, most technically ambitious patches in EMEA. Our customers are digital-native and cloud-native companies who build on the frontier: they adopt GenAI early, scale fast, and expect their technical partners to be as sharp as their own engineers. You will be the go-to expert our Account Teams and customers turn to when a GenAI or LLM use case needs to move from an ambitious idea to a production-grade reality across our high-growth accounts. This is a highly technical, customer-facing individual contributor role for someone who lives at the frontier of applied GenAI. You will shape architectures, prove out the hard problems, challenge and influence customer roadmaps, and raise the GenAI capability of the entire EMEA Emerging DNB field organisation. What You'll Do Serve as the deep technical authority on Generative AI, LLMs, and applied machine learning for the EMEA Emerging DNB business unit, supporting the most strategic and complex customer engagements across our digital-native and born-in-the-cloud accounts. Partner with our EMEA Emerging DNB Solutions Architects, Solutions Engineers, and Account teams to scope, design, and de-risk GenAI use cases — from retrieval-augmented generation and agentic systems to fine-tuning and evaluation. Build hands-on proofs of concept and reference implementations that operationalise large-scale LLM and deep learning workloads on Databricks (Mosaic AI, MLflow, Model Serving, Vector Search, Unity Catalog governance), tuned to the fast iteration cycles Emerging DNB customers expect. Lead fine-tuning and model-customisation engagements on open LLMs (e.g., Llama-family models), including judge-based and label-efficient evaluation approaches for domains where quality and safety are paramount. Act as a bridge to Product and Engineering — channel field and customer feedback into the roadmap and represent the roadmap back to the field. Enable and mentor the broader EMEA Emerging DNB Field Engineering team through workshops, reference architectures, and internal enablement, multiplying GenAI expertise across our ~70-person SA/SE organisation. Represent Databricks externally as a technical thought leader — conference talks (e.g., Data + AI Summit), blogs, and customer executive briefings. What We're Looking For Strong understanding of the LLM landscape, including leading proprietary and open-source models and providers, with the ability to differentiate their capabilities, trade-offs, and suitability for different use cases, and to articulate a clear, informed point of view (POV) to customers. Deep expertise in the modern GenAI stack: LLM application patterns (RAG, agents, tool use), fine-tuning and model customization, prompt and evaluation engineering, and LLM guardrails/safety. Strong foundations in machine learning and deep learning, including distributed training, GPU workloads, and the full MLOps lifecycle (tracking, registry, serving, monitoring). Proficiency in Python and the ML ecosystem (PyTorch/Transformers, MLflow, Spark), and comfort building production-quality reference implementations. Experience with the Databricks platform — or the ability to ramp on it quickly — including Mosaic AI, Model Serving, Vector Search, and Unity Catalog. Cloud experience across AWS, Azure, or GCP. Excellent communication and consultative skills: able to earn the trust of both hands-on engineers and senior technical executives, and to explain complex GenAI trade-offs clearly. A track record of technical leadership and mentorship — someone who elevates the people around them. Comfort operating at the pace of digital-native and high-growth customers, where speed, iteration, and technical credibility win the deal. Based in the United Kingdom and able to work across EMEA time zones, with willingness to travel to customer sites within the region as needed. Background helping digital-native customers build data and ML solutions (e.g., prior experience at a data/ML platform or consulting vendor) is a strong plus. Nice to Have Public technical presence: conference speaking, published talks, blogs, or open-source contributions in the ML/GenAI space. Domain depth in a regulated or high-stakes industry (healthcare/life sciences, financial services) where model quality, evaluation, and safety are critical. Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmap. Why This Role You will work on the hardest and most exciting GenAI problems our EMEA Emerging DNB customers have — companies building the future in real time — with the platform and the people to actually solve them, not just advise. You'll shape how one of EMEA's highest-growth business units adopts Generative AI, influence the direction of the product, and build a public profile as a recognised expert in the field. This is the role for a builder and a teacher, who wants their expertise to have outsized impact. About Databricks Databricks is the Data and AI company. Greenhouse: Databricks:8564394002.description: Databricks — the global leader in data and AI — is looking for a motivated Legal Counsel to play a key role in our growing EMEA business. Greenhouse: Databricks:8716189002.description: RDQ427R541 At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's most challenging problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI platform, enabling our customers to use deep data insights to improve their businesses. Our ability to execute this mission depends on building trust and recognition within an ever-growing community of data engineers, analysts, scientists, machine learning practitioners, and AI practitioners. Databricks’ Developer Relations team is looking for a leader to manage our open source Developer Advocates, deepen our engagement across the Apache Software Foundation and Linux Foundation communities, and lead technical storytelling and experiences that strengthen trust and adoption. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in the spotlight, is known and respected in open source communities, and gets even more satisfaction from growing other advocates than from giving the keynote themselves. As the Developer Advocate Manager for Open Source, you'll lead the team that advocates for the projects Databricks builds in the open, and serve as a crucial link between our engineering teams and the global community of practitioners building their careers on them. Your team's remit spans the Open Lakehouse — Apache Spark™ (including Spark Declarative Pipelines), Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Apache Iceberg™, and MLflow — as well as Omnigent, our open source meta-harness for composing, governing, and sharing AI agents. As the original creators of Apache Spark™, Delta Lake, and MLflow, we hold ourselves to a high standard here: our credibility in these communities is earned continuously, not inherited. This role will leverage your expertise in building and scaling a developer relations team, and it will build on your standing within the open source world and your working relationships with the Apache Software Foundation, the Linux Foundation, and the maintainers and committers who keep these projects healthy. You'll coach your team on building a content flywheel — where a single demo, video, or talk becomes the source of truth for a dozen derivative assets — and on applying AI as a force multiplier without ever lowering the technical bar. Your responsibilities will encompass both team leadership and a wide range of knowledge-sharing activities. You'll lead by example: delivering engaging talks, hosting panels and meetups, creating blogs and video content, developing courseware, answering questions in community forums, and meeting one-on-one with influential contributors and maintainers. Community engagement will be at the heart of your role. You'll work closely with the open source communities and with product and engineering teams, ensuring that community needs and product development align seamlessly. Reporting directly to the Head of Developer Relations, you'll collaborate with fellow DevRel managers across our Databricks, App Dev, and DevRel Programs teams to create a cohesive and impactful open source strategy. The ideal candidate embodies the values of our Developer Relations team: a deep passion for data and AI, genuine empathy for developers' needs, and a real, demonstrated commitment to open source — including the parts that don't directly benefit Databricks. More about the DevRel team The Developer Relations (DevRel) team at Databricks is dedicated to building and fostering relationships with communities of data practitioners. Our goal is to drive awareness and adoption of the Databricks Data + AI Platform — including Lakeflow, Lakebase, Genie Agents, and AI/BI — alongside the open source projects that underpin it, such as Apache Spark™, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, MLflow, Apache Iceberg™, and Omnigent. Our team also owns programs like the Databricks MVP program, the user group program, and DevConnect roadshows. The impact you will have Own developer relations for our open source portfolio end-to-end — set the strategy, define what success looks like, and be accountable for the outcomes. Hire, level, and grow a team of Developer Advocates, and take real ownership of their careers: clear expectations, honest feedback, and a visible path forward. Strengthen Databricks' standing as a trusted, vendor-neutral participant in the Apache and Linux Foundation ecosystems — measured by what the projects gain, not only by what we gain. Establish repeatable advocacy approaches — content flywheels, contribution guides, event playbooks — that the rest of DevRel can adopt and replicate. Grow external, non-Databricks adoption and contribution across our open source projects, and help develop the next generation of maintainers. Drive awareness and adoption of the Open Lakehouse and Omnigent through your own speaking at industry events and conferences, and by getting your team on the right stages. Guide the creation of high-quality educational content — videos, sample notebooks, datasets, tutorials, courseware, and blog posts — that meets a high technical bar. Expand and nurture these communities by growing meetups and user groups and supporting practitioners in online communities, mailing lists, and issue trackers. Represent the community inside R&D, turning contributor friction into a documented, prioritized roadmap change. Apply AI-assisted workflows to increase your team's leverage while maintaining technical depth and originality. Define and defend meaningful success metrics for an open source DevRel team, and be able to explain them to executives. What we look for 8+ years of combined experience in developer relations or developer advocacy and in a hands-on technical role — software engineer, data engineer, solutions architect, or similar. 2+ years managing and growing a developer relations team, including hiring, leveling, and promoting advocates. You have done the work yourself. You've written the posts, built the demos, given the talks, filed the issues, and sat in the forums — and you can still do all of it. A substantial, verifiable open source track record: sustained contribution, and experience with project governance, release processes, and community norms. Established relationships within the Apache Software Foundation and Linux Foundation ecosystems, and a clear understanding of how to engage them well. Deep knowledge of the Open Lakehouse stack — Apache Spark™, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Apache Iceberg™, and MLflow — and a working understanding of the agentic open source landscape, including Omnigent. Subject matter knowledge of solving data engineering, data science, or data analytics problems at scale. A genuine passion for growing people and building strong teams. Active participation and recognized leadership in open source community forums, chats, and meetups. Proven track record in nurturing developer communities, organizing user groups, and facilitating global meetups. Exceptional communication skills, with a talent for articulating complex concepts through writing, teaching, video, and public speaking. Experience using AI to scale a team's output without lowering the technical bar. Adept at collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to align community initiatives with product objectives. Greenhouse: Databricks:8176503002.description: RDQ226R533 At Databricks, we are passionate about helping data teams solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to solve technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started. We are the “AI/BI” team responsible for making Databricks the best product for business users to create, find and consume data insights. We work on 4 key pillars Dashboards, Genie, Databricks One and Unity Catalog Business semantics. UC Business semantics allow users to define business metrics and agent metadata in centrally governed systems for trusted access. Databricks One offers users a simplified experience tailored for non technical users to find and consume data insights. Genie lets users talk to their data with state of the art text-to-SQL and Dashboards lets users run their day to day business. We're seeking a dedicated Engineering Leader who will help grow the Data visualization and UC Business Semantics teams.These teams will be tackling a number of challenging fullstack problem spaces, including: making visualizations easy to consume, enabling dashboards to be highly interactive, creating compelling augmented analytics experiences, providing best in class low/no code authoring, and increasing the analytical expressivity of our business semantics products. You will report directly to the Senior Manager of Engineering. The main responsibilities include: You will lead a talented engineering team of full stack engineers and SMEs focused on one of the above initiatives. You will oversee sustained recruitment of top-tier talent, and developing talent on the team. You will build processes to implement product vision and strategy, according to organizational goals and priorities. You will build software that is not just high quality, but easy to operate. You will manage technical debt, including long-term technical architecture decisions, and balance product roadmap. What we look for: Great at hiring and developing talent Great at creating efficient processes that increase velocity and quality 2+ years of experience in managing teams that build and operate systems in a SaaS environment 5+ years of experience with distributed systems and building platforms and services and best in class application experience which serve multiple product teams and customers Have experience in scaling engineering teams from 5 to 20+ Team player that will work with other departments (PM, CS) and engineering teams. BS or higher in Computer Science, or a related field Strong track record of attracting, hiring, and retaining top engineering talent Experience managing distributed teams across multiple locations. Greenhouse: Databricks:8557075002.description: REQ ID - FEQ227R90 Location: Toronto, ON The Databricks Field Engineering team activates and accelerates the value our customers get from their data and AI.  Major Enterprises in Canada are leveraging the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform to securely deliver AI’s potential to every audience, at scale.  Our Field Engineering team is hiring a dynamic Solution Architecture leader who is not only focused on team culture but also can translate their team vision into a tangible and effective strategy in order to drive our customers’ data and AI experiences forward. Reporting to the Director of Field Engineering, the Manager, Field Engineering will help lead a team of SAs for the Commercial and Enterprise segment of Databricks’ Field Engineering team focused on the Financial Services Industry. You will lead and promote a dynamic team focusing on enterprise software, big data/analytics, data engineering, and data science. Leading the technical split-focused team (70% pre-sales, 30% technical acumen/demonstrations), you will partner with Sales (and other Field Engineering technical segments)  to increase revenue and help customers become wildly successful. You'll scale and maintain an outstanding Field Engineering team that is efficient in its operations to help accelerate Databricks' growth in the market. The impact you will have: You will hire, train, grow and manage a team of Solutions Architects for a company in high-growth mode. Make your customers extremely successful with Databricks and provide outsized value to their businesses. You will maintain a robust hiring pipeline at all times. Establish relationships across the business to make your customers and team successful. Partner with sales leadership to hit sales and consumption targets and ensure customer success Keep your team of SAs ahead of the technical curve. An SA adds value by maintaining a deep understanding of the technology stack. You will make sure that your team is continuously learning and working to provide our customers with the most comprehensive solutions for their needs What we look for: 3+ years of experience building and leading technical pre-sales teams - hiring, onboarding, and enabling pre- and post-sales professionals 7+ years of experience in the data space with a technical product (i.e. data warehousing, big data, or machine learning). A deep technical understanding of the impact which Data & AI can drive within  various industry segments Trusted advisor to technical executives that guide strategic data infrastructure decisions. Lead a team through best practices for technical qualification, proof of concepts, architecture discussions, and product demonstrations. Experience hiring candidates, ramping them up to be successful, and promoting into larger roles. Create a positive morale for the team and help foster a working relationship between Field Engineering, Sales, and other important internal partners. Experience working with other teams such as Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Customer Success. Must be technical enough to earn the trust of Engineering talent and leadership Databricks. Demonstrated architectural influence. Able to influence and review complex architectures, guiding your team and customers towards ideal solutions that scale. Greenhouse: Databricks:8755470002.title: Manager, Field Engineering - Global Telecommunications
Greenhouse: Databricks:8755470002.description: FEQ227R233 MANAGER, FIELD ENGINEERING About the Role As a Manager, Field Engineering, you will lead a team of technical customer advisors who help organizations solve complex data, analytics, and AI challenges. You will work closely with Sales and cross-functional partners to translate customer priorities into effective technical strategies, strong customer outcomes, and durable business impact. This role is typically aligned to an account district, patch, segment, or comparable portfolio and leads a team of approximately 8–10 Field Engineering professionals. You will stay close to the work while building the coaching, operating, and collaboration practices that enable your team to succeed. The Impact You Will Have Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing and inclusive Field Engineering team. Partner with account teams to define technical-win strategy, qualify opportunities, prioritize customer needs, and align team resources. Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders, including Director-, Head of, and VP-level audiences as appropriate to the engagement. Guide discovery, solution strategy, architecture discussions, adoption planning, and value realization for customer engagements. Establish regular operating rhythms to inspect progress, customer health, technical risk, escalations, capacity, and business impact. Coach team members to communicate clearly, navigate ambiguity, influence stakeholders, and connect technical recommendations to business outcomes. Maintain technical credibility across Databricks platform concepts, data and AI technologies, cloud architecture, governance, security, and networking. Represent customer needs internally and partner with Product, Engineering, Support, Professional Services, Marketing, and Partners to resolve issues and improve outcomes. Create a culture of psychological safety, inclusion, accountability, continuous learning, and recognition. Experiment with AI-enabled tools and repeatable practices that improve team productivity and customer impact. What We Look For Experience leading technical customer-facing professionals in enterprise software, cloud, data, AI, analytics, technical consulting, or a related environment. A track record of hiring, coaching, motivating, and retaining strong technical talent. Ability to provide timely feedback, hold clear career conversations, recognize contributions, and address performance issues directly and compassionately. Strong customer-advisory skills, including discovery, executive communication, technical storytelling, and value-based solutioning. Practical technical judgment and the ability to coach team members through architecture, deployment, adoption, and risk discussions. Operational discipline: you use data and inspection mechanisms to identify issues, make priorities visible, remove blockers, and drive predictable execution. An AI-first, builder mindset: you learn quickly, test new approaches, incorporate feedback, and use AI to improve customer and team outcomes. Demonstrated alignment with Databricks Culture Principles, including humility, curiosity, transparency, inclusion, and accountability. Basic Qualifications Experience managing or leading a technical customer-facing team. Experience partnering with Sales and cross-functional teams through complex, multi-stakeholder customer engagements. Experience in data platforms, analytics, AI, cloud, software, technical consulting, or a related technical domain. Strong written, verbal, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Databricks or comparable data and AI platforms. Experience building trusted relationships with senior technical and business stakeholders. Experience using data, automation, or AI-enabled tools to improve team effectiveness. Experience supporting customers across multiple use cases, technical environments, or business functions. #CMEG Pay Range Transparency Databricks is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Based on the factors above, Databricks anticipated utilizing the full width of the range. The total compensation package for this position may also include eligibility for annual performance bonus, equity, and the benefits listed above. For more information regarding which range your location is in visit our page here . Positioned at the intersection of complex cloud architecture and enterprise business value, you will serve as a pivotal technical leader driving Databricks’ market expansion and customer acceleration across the EE region. In this role, you will partner with Enterprise Sales leadership to technical sales cycles, build strategic C-level alignment, and establish a repeatable technical motion. You will balance strategic regional planning with hands-on technical guidance helping your team architect modern Data & AI solutions while maintaining a bar-raising, inclusive engineering culture. The Impact You Will Have Scale & Enable Technical Talent: Hire, onboard, and mentor a top-tier pre-sales engineering team across Eastern Europe, maintaining a robust talent pipeline and fostering continuous technical enablement on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform Drive Consumption-Based Growth: Partner closely with Sales leadership to accurately forecast, technically qualify, and accelerate enterprise sales cycles, linking technical validations (PoCs/PVs) directly to long-term consumption and measurable customer ROI. Cultivate Value-Engineered Solutions: Institute rigorous pre-sales methodologies that shift conversations from feature lists to strategic business outcomes, establishing your team as trusted architectural advisors to customer CTOs, CDOs, and Chief AI Officers. Build Executive & Strategic Alignment: Engage directly with key customer executives and regional System Integrator (SI) / Cloud Service Provider (CSP) partners to secure reference architectures, co-selling motions, and successful downstream implementation strategies. Foster an Inclusive, Builder-First Culture: Promote a customer-obsessed, highly collaborative engineering team culture rooted in technical curiosity, architectural excellence, and diversity of thought. Expand Regional Brand & Market Presence: Act as a key technical leader in Eastern Europe in partnership with Regional Marketing and Field Leadership to drive community engagement, executive roundtables, and developer events. What We Look For Pre-Sales Engineering Leadership: Proven track record of building, coaching, and scaling technical pre-sales or solutions architecture teams within a hyper-growth SaaS, Cloud, or Enterprise Data/AI ecosystem. Deep Domain Expertise: Background as a practitioner or technical consultant in at least one core technical domain. Consumption & Commercial Acumen: Hands-on understanding of consumption-driven SaaS business models, technical pipeline management, and strategic deal-qualification frameworks (e.g., MEDDPICC). Architectural Authority: Ability to review, challenge, and influence complex multi-cloud data architectures (AWS, Azure, GCP) to earn the immediate trust of customer engineering teams and internal product leaders. Executive Presence: Strong communication, whiteboarding, and storytelling skills; adept at translating complex distributed systems concepts into clear executive business drivers. Regional Language Capabilities: Professional fluency in English is required. Fluency in one or more Eastern European languages (e.g., Polish (preferred) , Greek, Romanian, Bulgarian, or Czech) is strongly preferred. About Databricks Databricks is the Data and AI company. Greenhouse: Databricks:8836690002.description: (FEQ427R544) Role Summary As a Field Engineering Manager, you will lead a high-performing team of technical pre-sales Solutions Architects (SAs) dedicated to enterprise Named Accounts across the Benelux region. You will operate at the intersection of deep technology and business strategy, driving platform adoption and enterprise AI initiatives. As a technically credible coach and AI builder , you will spend meaningful time in the field (~30-40%) partnering with customer executives and internal Sales counterparts. You will lead by example to instil an AI-Builder Mindset across your team, establish rigorous operational inspection cadences, coach SAs through complex architecture designs without taking the pen, and decisively build an elite pre-sales organisation. The Impact You Will Have Build & Scale Elite Teams: Hire, mentor, and retain exceptional Solutions Engineers/Architects in the Benelux region, establishing high standards for technical excellence, inclusive leadership, and decisive performance management. Drive AI Adoption & Capabilities: Lead by example as an AI practitioner, embedding AI tools into team workflows and driving scalable capability across the organisation. Act as a Customer Advisor: Build trusted relationships with C-level and senior technical executives across customer accounts. Translate complex platform capabilities into measurable business ROI (e.g., predictive maintenance, yield optimisation, supply chain resilience). Drive Operational Execution: Co-own regional consumption and growth targets with Sales partners. Maintain rigorous inspection cadences across pipeline health, technical validation, and account strategy. Technically Coach the Field: Serve as an architectural sounding board for your team. Diagnose platform designs, spot failure modes in distributed systems or AI infrastructure, and coach SAs to refine architectures independently. Expand Benelux Presence: Serve as a key regional leader helping build Databricks' brand and market presence across enterprise accounts. What We’re Looking For Technical Pre-Sales Leadership: Track record of managing or leading technical pre-sales or consulting teams in Cloud Data Platforms, Enterprise Software, or AI/ML ecosystems. AI-Builder Mindset: Hands-on experience leveraging modern AI tools personally and a demonstrated ability to drive AI capability and productivity across an engineering team. Domain Credibility: Deep understanding of data challenges within relevant industries. Customer Advisor Presence: Ability to build direct relationships with VP/C-level stakeholders and frame technical decisions around commercial value and consumption growth. Architectural Coaching Capability: Hands-on foundation in data engineering, distributed systems, cloud architecture (AWS/Azure/GCP), or enterprise ML/AI pipelines, with the discipline to coach SAs rather than taking over technical delivery. Execution & Rigour: Experience managing against consumption/usage business models, running structured deal inspection cadences, and redesigning sub-scale operational processes. Basic Qualifications Experience managing or leading a technical customer-facing team. Experience partnering with Sales and cross-functional teams through complex, multi-stakeholder customer engagements. Experience in data platforms, analytics, AI, cloud, software, technical consulting, or a related technical domain. Strong written, verbal, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Databricks or comparable data and AI platforms. Experience building trusted relationships with senior technical and business stakeholders. Experience using data, automation, or AI-enabled tools to improve team effectiveness. Experience supporting customers across multiple use cases, technical environments, or business functions. As Manager, Forward Deployed Engineering for Singapore, you will lead a high-performing team of Forward Deployed Engineers and AI Engineers at the forefront of this transformation. As a people leader, you will build and scale a team that represents Databricks' highest standard of technical excellence and customer impact. You will set the bar for delivery quality, grow world-class talent, and drive the strategic governance framework that ensures every engagement is executed with precision and measurable impact.
