Greenhouse: Databricks:8633071002.title: P2P Data & Automation Lead
Greenhouse: Databricks:8633071002.description: GAQ327R181 While candidates in the listed location(s) are encouraged for this role, candidates in other locations will be considered. Databricks is executing a multi-year Procure-to-Pay transformation spanning an expense management platform migration, the BrickBuy enterprise procurement portal, a managed services onboarding, and policy and process redesign initiatives. This role sits embedded within Procurement — not in a central IT or analytics function — and operates in accordance with the Finance Data Strategy governance framework to drive rapid P2P process transformation by designing, deploying, and scaling automation and data solutions directly within business workflows. This is a builder role for someone who wants to own outcomes, not tickets: the person will sit inside the processes they are automating, ship working solutions in weeks rather than quarters, and carry them through adoption — pairing hands-on technical delivery with the change management discipline needed to make new ways of working stick. The impact you will have: Business process ownership. Own designated P2P sub-processes end to end — intake-to-PO, invoice exception handling, supplier onboarding, expense workflows — including process mapping, baseline metrics (cycle time, touch rates, exception volumes), and redesign. Act as the recognized process owner who is accountable for how the process performs, not just how it is documented. Requirements & solution design. Translate pain points raised by requesters, approvers, buyers, and AP into structured requirements and solution designs. Work within the Finance Data Strategy governance framework for data definitions, source-of-truth alignment, access controls, and quality standards — solutions must tie to certified Finance data, not shadow datasets. Embedded automation. Design, deploy, and scale automations directly within business workflows and the systems where work actually happens (ZIP, SAP, NetSuite, expense platform, BrickBuy) — including AI/LLM-assisted triage, auto-routing, data enrichment, exception auto-resolution, and notification/nudge logic. Build in production-adjacent environments with appropriate guardrails rather than standalone tools users must remember to visit. Rapid iteration. Operate on a ship-measure-iterate cadence: release minimum viable automations in weeks, instrument them from day one, and refine based on usage data and user feedback. Maintain sandbox-to-production discipline consistent with Finance Data Strategy and SOX/control requirements. Data & measurement. Build and maintain the P2P datasets, dashboards, and metrics that the transformation runs on — cycle time, Fast Pass performance, first-pass yield, policy compliance, automation coverage, and adoption rates — and report against them in existing operating rhythms (e.g., quarterly business reviews), with numbers that tie across reports and to source data. User adoption & change management. Own the adoption of what you build. Design role-based training and enablement for affected requesters, approvers, and P2P operations staff; produce launch communications, FAQ/help content, and go-live announcements in a style consistent with executive reporting norms (concise, structured, blockers called out explicitly); run feedback loops with change champions across subsidiaries; and actively identify and mitigate resistance rather than assuming usage will follow deployment. Day-to-day prioritization. Run the intake and backlog for automation and data requests across Procurement: triage incoming asks, prioritize by value, effort, and risk, publish a visible roadmap, and make defensible trade-off calls daily — protecting capacity for transformation priorities while handling operational requests. Stakeholder engagement. Greenhouse: Databricks:8644000002.description: FEQ327R583 The Partner Enablement Operations Manager is a senior operator and builder responsible for designing and running a scalable, predictable, and data-driven operating model for partner enablement at Databricks. This role serves as the operational backbone and strategic integrator for partner enablement, connecting global strategy to regional execution across AMER, EMEA, and APJ regions while ensuring programs are delivered consistently, efficiently, and at scale. The ideal candidate brings strong executive presence, systems thinking, and a bias for automation. They know how to reduce operational friction, build governance that scales, and introduce AI-enabled workflows that improve responsiveness without adding unnecessary complexity or headcount. We are looking for A builder who can architect operating systems, drive cross-functional alignment, and convert recurring operational friction into structural improvement. What You’ll Do Own the partner enablement operating model, including core planning cadences, governance mechanisms, and execution frameworks that connect strategy to execution. Run QBRs, MBRs, and executive reviews for partner enablement leadership, using clear metrics and forward-looking insights to drive accountability and decision-making. Lead end-to-end execution of partner enablement initiatives, ensuring timelines, dependencies, and deliverables are managed effectively across functions and regions. Build and maintain dashboards and operating reviews that surface partner engagement, program performance, risk signals, and areas requiring intervention. Act as a key point of contact for cross-regional operational issues and escalations, resolving immediate friction while converting recurring issues into structural improvements. Design and implement scalable workflows, SOPs, SLAs, and intake mechanisms that improve consistency, reduce manual effort, and create a better experience for internal stakeholders and partners. Introduce AI-enabled and automation-first workflows for intake, reporting, support, certification, and partner operations where they can safely improve speed, quality, and scale. Collaborate closely with the Partner organization, Learning and Enablement, Professional Services, and other cross-functional teams to remove friction and improve execution across the partner ecosystem. Partner closely with the broader operations business to drive cross-functional leverage of ideas and excellence, ensuring new methods and operational innovations are scaled beyond just partner operations. Establish clear ownership models, decision rights, and governance guardrails to support regional nuance without creating shadow processes or operational inconsistencies. Architect and maintain automated intake management workflows and SLA tracking mechanisms to optimize request processing and eliminate wait-time bottlenecks. Establish standardized metric definitions and executive reporting frameworks that pair activity and outcome indicators to ensure reporting integrity across cross-functional teams. What You Bring Required Qualifications 10+ years of experience in Learning Operations, Program Management, Professional Services Operations, or a related operational leadership field in a high-growth technology environment. Proven experience supporting global or multi-region teams and translating central strategy into executable operating plans. Preferred experience in the Data & AI space, with a strong understanding of Databricks' platform capabilities, key differentiators, and end-to-end solutions, and the ability to work effectively with technical stakeholders. Demonstrated ownership of operating cadence, forecasting, planning, and execution frameworks in a complex, matrixed environment. Strong analytical capability and the ability to turn data into executive insight, operational decisions, and measurable business outcomes. Experience improving processes and workflows, with a clear track record of reducing manual effort and increasing scale through automation or AI-enabled solutions. Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions without direct authority. Ability to work independently, manage priorities across time zones, and drive execution in ambiguous, fast-moving environments. Must be open to working a flexible schedule, including frequent late hours to accommodate discussions with the broader enablement team and partner liaisons, the majority of whom are based in the AMER timezone. Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional alignment and lead strategic delivery across matrixed global organizations. Experience designing and optimizing workflow automation, structured intake management, and operational reporting engines with strict metric definition discipline. Preferred Qualifications Experience in partner enablement, customer education, learning operations, or training operations. Deep expertise working with and for System Integrators (SIs) and ISVs, with a strong grasp of their core operational principles and business models. Fluency with AI tools, workflow automation, and analytics platforms used to streamline operations and generate actionable insights. Strong commercial and operational acumen, including comfort with utilization, forecasting, partner spend, margin thinking, or RevOps-aligned execution. Experience operating in a highly matrixed international environment with sensitivity to regional and cultural nuance. Why Join Us You will play a central role in shaping how partner enablement scales at Databricks. This is a high-visibility role with meaningful impact, offering the opportunity to build a more efficient, governed, and AI-enabled operating model that helps our partner ecosystem grow with the business. If you enjoy turning ambiguity into structure, building systems that remove friction, and helping teams scale through better operations rather than more manual work, this role is for you. Success Metrics Operational Predictability: Build a disciplined partner enablement operating cadence where risks are surfaced early and execution is measurable and consistent. Stakeholder Experience and Self-Sufficiency: Increase the percentage of standard partner enablement requests handled through structured, low-touch, or self-service workflows. Escalation Management and Process Resilience: Reduce recurring operational friction by improving escalation handling, clarifying ownership, and improving systemic resolution of recurring issues. Scalable Execution: Improve throughput, consistency, and delivery quality across global partner enablement programs without relying on incremental manual work. AI-Enabled Transformation: Deploy practical AI-enabled workflows that improve speed, visibility, and efficiency across intake, reporting, support, and partner operations. This is a highly visible, strategic role: you set the agenda across Sales, Field Engineering, Marketing, Partner Solution Architecture, and the partner ecosystem, and you carry Databricks' Manufacturing & Energy partner narrative to senior partner and customer executives. You will own and grow relationships with strategic partners across the vertical — including global and regional systems integrators such as Accenture, Deloitte, Capgemini, and IBM, and specialist data and AI partners — and you bring deep industry knowledge and an operator's mindset powered by modern AI tooling. Reporting to the Senior Director, Partner Sales. The impact you will have: Build and own the pipeline engine — architect the Manufacturing & Energy partner GTM strategy and convert it into durable, partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and consumption across the vertical. Drive partner execution and accountability — hold strategic SI/ISV partners to joint commitments; inspect co-sell motions rigorously and remove friction so partners execute effectively against shared pipeline and revenue goals. Lead solution development with partners — co-create differentiated, industry-specific joint solutions, accelerators, and repeatable GTM plays that pair partner capability with the Databricks platform to solve high-value Manufacturing & Energy use cases. Run a disciplined operating cadence — pipeline reviews, forecast, and KPI inspection anchored to Salesforce as the system of record; report impact, not activity. Own the executive relationship and narrative — build joint business plans and executive-ready narratives, and represent Databricks credibly to senior partner and customer leadership. Orchestrate cross-functional alignment — set direction across Sales, Field Engineering, Marketing, Partner Solution Architecture, and partner leadership, resolving friction and keeping strategic deals moving. Apply an operator mindset with AI-driven tools to improve forecasting accuracy, pipeline quality, solution development speed, and partner attribution. What we look for: 8+ years in partner/alliance sales, channel, or GTM at an enterprise software, cloud, or data company; proven track record of building partner-sourced pipeline and driving measurable revenue impact. Demonstrated ability to hold partners accountable and drive effective joint execution — from account planning through co-sell to closed consumption. Experience developing joint solutions with SI/ISV partners — translating industry use cases into repeatable, differentiated offerings. Track record of cross-functional leadership across Sales, Field/technical, Marketing, and partners in a matrixed environment. Strong executive presence — shapes a business narrative and aligns senior internal, partner, and customer stakeholders. Operational rigor: clean pipeline hygiene, KPI discipline, and data-driven inspection. Industry fluency and across Manufacturing and Energy — understanding of the sector value chain and how data and AI create value across it; ability to translate industry use cases into joint partner solutions and GTM plays. Demonstrated expertise across Energy sub-sectors (Oil & Gas, Power & Utilities), leading cross-functional initiatives in complex regulatory environments Fluency with modern AI productivity tools to drive analysis, solution development, and operating efficiency. Ability to travel as needed (approximately 25–40%) for partner business reviews, account-planning workshops, industry summits, and customer/partner executive engagements. Greenhouse: Databricks:8604587002.description: GAQ327R159 While candidates in the listed location(s) are encouraged for this role, candidates in other locations will be considered. The Payroll Tax Manager will be our internal subject matter expert on all things payroll tax, advising payroll, equity, HR, and accounting teams on legislative changes, validating existing and new positions, developing global payroll tax policy, and generally helping the business better understand and report its payroll tax obligations. This role will also lead all payroll tax audits and inquiries from revenue authorities while advising the business on best practices and minimizing payroll tax risk. The Payroll Tax Manager’s role is to elevate all of their partners' operations and ensure the business and its employees (Bricksters) are reporting the right amount of tax in the right periods. The impact you will have: Payroll Tax Advisory Partner with our global payroll team to review payroll tax calculations and document technical positions. Identify opportunities for refunds or otherwise de-risk our global payroll tax positions. Support M&A integration to ensure pre- and post-close payroll tax positions are supported and optimized for the business. Work alongside our equity administration group to validate equity withholding and assist with other shareholder transaction planning. Assist our payroll team with global payroll tax communications and responses to employee inquiries. Collaborate with other tax team members on payroll tax matters that impact our global direct and indirect tax matters, such as gross receipts taxes and business-level employer taxes. Partner with our equity administration team to ensure that equity tax reporting is accurately reflected in our payroll tax filings and collaborate to solve cross-functional payroll tax matters. Audit Readiness Lead global payroll tax audits (internal and external) by responding to information requests, communicating our positions, and remediating any identified exposures. Guide global payroll tax policy and implementation. Assist the accounting team to help reconcile payroll tax accounts, investigate variances, and resolve discrepancies. Maintain comprehensive documentation to support compliance and audit requirements. Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborate with HR, Finance, Accounting, Equity Administration, Legal, and Benefits on cross-functional initiatives including employee versus EOR decisions, and new entity creation. Participate in M&A due diligence and integration activities to ensure accurate tax setup and reporting. Partner with our Finance Data Team and other stakeholders to re-imagine the payroll tax reporting process and identify opportunities to build on Databricks technology. What we look for: Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field. 5+ years of payroll tax experience. Strong knowledge of US federal, state, and local payroll tax regulations. Knowledge of international payroll tax regulations. Knowledge of equity compensation tax matters. Experience with payroll systems and tax filing platforms (SAP, NetSuite, Workday preferred). Experience leveraging automation tools or AI at work. Experience with payroll tax audits and negotiating with revenue authorities. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Workday. Experience with mobility tax issues (state-to-state or country-to-country). Experience in large, complex, multinational organizations. Greenhouse: Databricks:8557780002.location: Mountain View, California; San Francisco, California
Greenhouse: Databricks:8557780002.description: Principal AI Research Scientist, Research Director - AI Scaling P-1227 About Databricks AI At Databricks, we are obsessed with enabling data teams to solve the world’s toughest problems, from security threat detection to cancer drug development, by building and running the world’s best data and AI platform. The Databricks AI Research organization enables companies to develop AI models and agents using their own data, with technologies ranging from post-training open source LLMs to developing advanced multi-agent architectures. Databricks AI is committed to the belief that a company’s AI models and agents are just as valuable as any other core IP, and that high-quality AI should be available to all. About the Scaling Research Team The Databricks AI Scaling team focuses on pushing the boundaries of large language model (LLM) training and inference efficiency beyond what is required to support existing models. The team explores novel avenues for scaling and efficiency improvements across algorithms, systems, and infrastructure, requiring researchers who can both drive independent research agendas and dive deep into low‑level implementation details with engineering partners. Role Summary As a Principal Research Scientist – AI Scaling, you will lead a team of world‑class researchers and engineers to advance the state of the art in large‑scale machine learning, focusing on post-training, RL and inference efficiency, optimization, and scaling. You will define and execute a research roadmap that advances the Databricks AI platform and delivers tangible improvements to how customers train, serve, and adapt LLMs at scale, working closely with product, data, and engineering leaders to bring cutting‑edge methods into production. The Impact You Will Have Lead and grow a multidisciplinary research team focused on foundational and applied AI problems, with a particular emphasis on LLM scaling, efficiency, and systems performance. Define the scaling research roadmap in alignment with Databricks’ strategic objectives, prioritizing advances in foundation model efficiency and large‑scale training and inference. Drive algorithmic innovations for large‑scale neural network training and inference, including novel optimizers, low‑precision techniques, and model adaptation methods, and guide your team in rigorous empirical validation against state‑of‑the‑art approaches. Optimize end‑to‑end ML systems for distributed training and RL, memory efficiency, and compute efficiency through close collaboration with core systems and platform teams, ensuring that research ideas translate into performant, reliable infrastructure. Partner with product and engineering to translate research breakthroughs, especially around scaling and efficiency, into customer‑impacting capabilities in the Databricks AI platform. Foster a culture of scientific excellence and openness, including high‑quality research practices, reproducible experimentation, and effective internal knowledge sharing across Databricks AI. Represent Databricks AI research externally through top‑tier publications, conference talks, and collaborations with academia and the open‑source community, with a focus on optimization and efficiency for large‑scale models. Mentor and develop talent, providing both technical guidance (research agendas, experimentation, implementation) and career development support for research scientists and engineers. What You Will Do Define and lead independent research programs on foundation model efficiency, covering topics such as optimizer design, low‑precision training/inference, scalable model architectures, and efficient adaptation methods. Oversee the design and execution of large‑scale experiments, including benchmarking against state‑of‑the‑art methods and evaluating trade‑offs in quality, latency, throughput, and cost. Work hands‑on with your team on high‑quality, efficient code in Python and PyTorch for research implementation, rapid prototyping, and integration with Databricks’ production systems. Collaborate with distributed systems and infra teams to push the limits of distributed training , parallelism strategies, memory management, and hardware utilization for LLMs and other large models. Establish metrics, evaluation protocols, and best practices for scaling‑focused research (e.g., training efficiency, inference cost, energy usage) and drive their adoption across Databricks AI. Champion responsible and robust deployment of scaling innovations, ensuring that model behavior, reliability, and safety remain first‑class considerations. What We Look For Proven ability to lead a research team to develop novel techniques for foundation model efficiency and related topics, with a strong track record of industry impact. Deep expertise in at least one of: generative AI, LLMs, distributed ML systems, model optimization, or responsible AI, with a strong emphasis on scaling and efficiency for large‑scale neural networks. Hands on leadership - strong programming skills and demonstrated ability to write high‑quality, efficient code in Python and PyTorch for research implementation and experimentation. Demonstrated ability to translate research innovation into scalable product capabilities in partnership with product and engineering teams. Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills, with experience influencing cross‑functional roadmaps and aligning research with business impact. Nice to Have Prior work at the intersection of systems and ML, such as distributed training frameworks, compiler and kernel optimization for deep learning workloads, or memory‑/compute‑efficient model design. Strong industry and academic network in large‑scale ML, with ongoing collaborations or service (e.g., PC/area chair) at top conferences in ML and systems. A strong record of research impact—such as first‑author publications at top ML/systems conferences (e.g., ICLR, ICML, NeurIPS, MLSys), influential open‑source contributions, or widely used deployed systems—especially in optimization or efficiency. Greenhouse: Databricks:8860653002.title: Principal Brand Content & AI Search Visibility
Greenhouse: Databricks:8860653002.description: MKTQ427R49 We're looking for a content lead who sits at the intersection of brand content storytelling and AI-era discoverability. You will own the creation of high-quality and high-volume brand content, ensuring that content is structured, distributed, and measured to win visibility across AI answer engines. You will produce and edit compelling content and employ optimization strategies to make sure LLMs discover, parse, and cite it. You will identify content gaps by analyzing where the brand is (and isn't) showing up in LLM answers, map those gaps against business objectives, target audiences, and product priorities, and orchestrate a mix of AI agents, technical writers, and internal teams to close them. A core part of this orchestration is overseeing a system of AI agents that create, optimize, and evaluate content — a task that requires real editorial expertise applied to prompt design and agent engineering, not just tool adoption. You will be responsible for building and maintaining the brand context, target prompts, and writing guidelines that guide agents and internal SMEs to create on-brand, accurate, and authoritative content. A major part of the role is editorial judgment: this includes reviewing drafts from agents and adjusting prompts and inputs to improve output quality. The impact you will have: Within 12–24 months in this role, success looks like: The content roadmap is driven by evidence. You've stood up ongoing GEO/AI answer analysis, and every major content bet ties back to a documented gap — where the brand is underrepresented, inaccurate, or absent — requiring gap-analysis skills and fluency with GEO/AI-visibility diagnostics. Business priorities and content output are in lockstep. The roadmap (blogs, video, web pages, thought leadership) is visibly built from business objectives, audience search intent, and product priorities, and stakeholders can trace any piece of content back to a prompt that justified it — requiring sharp prioritization judgment and the ability to translate business strategy into editorial direction. A multi-resource content engine runs smoothly. Agencies, freelance contractors, internal writers/producers, and AI content agents are each matched to the content types they're best suited for; workflows include adequate content review, and handoffs don't create bottlenecks — all of which require strong orchestration and tool/vendor/contributor management skills. Every piece of published content clears the bar you’ve set for that medium. You're the final editorial checkpoint on all content — agency, contractor, internal, or AI-generated — and your revision notes are specific enough to reliably lift drafts to brand standard, requiring proven editorial judgment across formats (long-form, blogs, video scripts, web copy). Content is winning visibility and citation share. Published content is structured to be entity-rich, answer-first, well-sourced, and citation-worthy for LLM retrieval, without losing readability or brand voice — requiring hands-on GEO/AEO expertise layered on solid SEO and writing fundamentals. Leadership can see the line from content to business outcome. You track GEO performance alongside traditional metrics and report on it regularly. The broader marketing team writes and creates with GEO/AI-visibility in mind by default . You've enabled marketers across the org on GEO prompts and tools, AI writing agents, brand context, and best practices for quality writing. What we look for: 10+ years in content strategy, brand content, or editorial leadership, with experience managing a mix of internal and external contributors. Strong editorial judgment — proven ability to review and elevate drafts across formats to a consistent brand standard. Working knowledge of SEO fundamentals plus hands-on recent GEO/AEO experience — comfortable diagnosing why a brand isn't being cited or surfaced correctly by LLMs. Experience managing agencies and/or freelance contractors, and comfort building and optimizing AI content tools/agents as part of a production workflow. Familiarity with GEO/AI-visibility tools such as Profound, Conductor, AirOps, Peec.ai, or similar platforms. Proficiency with Semrush, Google Search Console, and Google Analytics (GA4) to track technical optimization and brand visibility in traditional search engines. Sharp analytical instincts paired with strong creative/editorial taste. Experience in B2B tech, data/AI, or enterprise SaaS. Familiarity with schema markup and structured data for AI/search discoverability. Experience overseeing video production workflows. Greenhouse: Databricks:8521190002.title: Principal Research Scientist – Scaling
Greenhouse: Databricks:8521190002.description: Principal Research Scientist – Scaling P-1227 About Databricks AI At Databricks, we are obsessed with enabling data teams to solve the world’s toughest problems, from security threat detection to cancer drug development, by building and running the world’s best data and AI platform. The Databricks AI Research organization enables companies to develop AI models and agents using their own data, with technologies ranging from post-training open source LLMs to developing advanced multi-agent architectures. Databricks AI is committed to the belief that a company’s AI models and agents are just as valuable as any other core IP, and that high-quality AI should be available to all. About the Scaling Research Team The Databricks AI Scaling team focuses on pushing the boundaries of large language model (LLM) training and inference efficiency beyond what is required to support existing models. The team explores novel avenues for scaling and efficiency improvements across algorithms, systems, and infrastructure, requiring researchers who can both drive independent research agendas and dive deep into low‑level implementation details with engineering partners. Role Summary As a Principal Research Scientist – Scaling, you will lead a team of world‑class researchers and engineers to advance the state of the art in large‑scale machine learning, focusing on post-training, RL and inference efficiency, optimization, and scaling. You will define and execute a research roadmap that advances the Databricks AI platform and delivers tangible improvements to how customers train, serve, and adapt LLMs at scale, working closely with product, data, and engineering leaders to bring cutting‑edge methods into production. The Impact You Will Have Lead and grow a multidisciplinary research team focused on foundational and applied AI problems, with a particular emphasis on LLM scaling, efficiency, and systems performance. Define the scaling research roadmap in alignment with Databricks’ strategic objectives, prioritizing advances in foundation model efficiency and large‑scale training and inference. Drive algorithmic innovations for large‑scale neural network training and inference, including novel optimizers, low‑precision techniques, and model adaptation methods, and guide your team in rigorous empirical validation against state‑of‑the‑art approaches. Optimize end‑to‑end ML systems for distributed training and RL, memory efficiency, and compute efficiency through close collaboration with core systems and platform teams, ensuring that research ideas translate into performant, reliable infrastructure. Partner with product and engineering to translate research breakthroughs, especially around scaling and efficiency, into customer‑impacting capabilities in the Databricks AI platform. Foster a culture of scientific excellence and openness, including high‑quality research practices, reproducible experimentation, and effective internal knowledge sharing across Databricks AI. Represent Databricks AI research externally through top‑tier publications, conference talks, and collaborations with academia and the open‑source community, with a focus on optimization and efficiency for large‑scale models. Mentor and develop talent, providing both technical guidance (research agendas, experimentation, implementation) and career development support for research scientists and engineers. What You Will Do Define and lead independent research programs on foundation model efficiency, covering topics such as optimizer design, low‑precision training/inference, scalable model architectures, and efficient adaptation methods. Oversee the design and execution of large‑scale experiments, including benchmarking against state‑of‑the‑art methods and evaluating trade‑offs in quality, latency, throughput, and cost. Work hands‑on with your team on high‑quality, efficient code in Python and PyTorch for research implementation, rapid prototyping, and integration with Databricks’ production systems. Collaborate with distributed systems and infra teams to push the limits of distributed training , parallelism strategies, memory management, and hardware utilization for LLMs and other large models. Establish metrics, evaluation protocols, and best practices for scaling‑focused research (e.g., training efficiency, inference cost, energy usage) and drive their adoption across Databricks AI. Champion responsible and robust deployment of scaling innovations, ensuring that model behavior, reliability, and safety remain first‑class considerations. What We Look For Proven ability to lead a research team to develop novel techniques for foundation model efficiency and related topics, with a strong track record of industry impact. Deep expertise in at least one of: generative AI, LLMs, distributed ML systems, model optimization, or responsible AI, with a strong emphasis on scaling and efficiency for large‑scale neural networks. Hands on leadership - strong programming skills and demonstrated ability to write high‑quality, efficient code in Python and PyTorch for research implementation and experimentation. Demonstrated ability to translate research innovation into scalable product capabilities in partnership with product and engineering teams. Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills, with experience influencing cross‑functional roadmaps and aligning research with business impact. Nice to Have Prior work at the intersection of systems and ML, such as distributed training frameworks, compiler and kernel optimization for deep learning workloads, or memory‑/compute‑efficient model design. Strong industry and academic network in large‑scale ML, with ongoing collaborations or service (e.g., PC/area chair) at top conferences in ML and systems. A strong record of research impact—such as first‑author publications at top ML/systems conferences (e.g., ICLR, ICML, NeurIPS, MLSys), influential open‑source contributions, or widely used deployed systems—especially in optimization or efficiency. Greenhouse: Databricks:8612863002.title: Principal Security Field Engineer
Greenhouse: Databricks:8612863002.description: RDQ327R177 While candidates in the listed location(s) are encouraged for this role, candidates in other US locations will be considered. The Security Field Engineering team helps data teams solve the world's toughest problems by empowering customers to understand the security of the Databricks platform and by helping account teams address questions that come up during security reviews. Reporting to the Head of Security Field Engineering, you will meet with customers to answer questions, train other Databricks team members, build customer-facing content such as slide decks, white papers, and maybe write code that customers can use. Our team prioritizes scale -- we'd rather spend an hour building a doc than be in ten hours of meetings, rather deliver agent skills and knowledge base articles than be the rock star answering all the questions. Reporting to the Director & Associate General Counsel, Commercial, you will act as the operational backbone for the public-sector contracting function, working in close coordination with Public Sector legal, sales, operations, product, engineering, finance, and other cross-functional stakeholders. This is a mission-critical and highly independent role designed for a proactive, focused person who thrives on building programs in-flight to drive accountability and positive, timely outcomes. You won't just track workstreams — you will own them. Scale Internationally: Develop and govern contracting programs for priority international markets to create repeatable processes to drive stakeholder engagement and forward progress. Drive Continuous Improvement: Constantly audit the status quo to support increasing scale and anticipate future needs before they arise. Develop training and GTM enablement for sales, delivery, finance, and partner teams. Handle Routine Contracting Matters: Support deal flow for initial triage (including pre-award RFI/RFP support and coordination) and routine matters (under attorney supervision). Partner/channel Experience: Prior work with various channel contracting structures (resellers, distributors, cloud marketplaces) is critical. SaaS & Cloud Contracting Fluency: Experience with subscription/consumption-based SaaS agreements and interactions with finance, deal desk, and security/product/privacy terms. You understand how commercial cloud contracting intersects with government procurement requirements. Builder Mentality: Demonstrated ability to build contracting operations from scratch with first-principles thinking and an eye to scale — intake, playbooks, dashboards, metrics, governance. You have done this before, not just maintained someone else's system. Interdependence without Authority: You thrive in matrixed, highly interdependent operations where your success depends on the systems you build and the depth and quality of your stakeholder relationships. You hold others accountable and expect the same of yourself. International Experience Welcomed: Experience with multi-jurisdictional government procurement and foreign language skills are a plus. Greenhouse: Databricks:8495067002.description: SLSQ427R275 This is not a role for someone who wants to inherit a playbook. As the Go-to-Market Leader for APAC Retail & Consumer Goods, you will architect and execute a category-defining strategy from the ground up. You'll operate with the mindset of a founder of a hyper-growth enterprise—a rare opportunity that demands entrepreneurial instincts, relentless drive, and the courage to build in ambiguity. Databricks is scaling at extraordinary speed. Databricks is the market share leader in data + AI in Retail & Consumer Goods, and this vertical represents one of the most significant growth opportunities in our portfolio. We need a leader who thrives in white space, who sees undefined territory not as risk but as canvas. You will shape how APAC’s largest retailers and consumer brands harness Data and AI to transform their operations, unlock new revenue streams, and reimagine customer experiences. You will report to the Global VP of Consumer Industries, but your impact will extend across the entire organization—influencing product direction, shaping partner ecosystems, and setting the strategic agenda for one of our most consequential markets. The impact you will have A Scalable APAC Growth Engine Design and execute a go-to-market strategy that doesn't yet exist in its final form. You’ll establish C-level relationships with flagship accounts, construct an ecosystem of ISVs, SIs, and alliance partners, and create repeatable motions that accelerate revenue growth across Retail, Consumer Goods, Restaurants, and Wholesale. Programmatic Opportunity Capture Identify the highest-value use cases and industry-specific opportunities—demand forecasting, unified customer intelligence, supply chain optimization, real-time pricing—and build scalable programs that systematically convert these opportunities into revenue. You won't pursue targets one at a time; you'll construct the engines, assets, and activation frameworks that allow us to capture entire categories of opportunity across the region simultaneously. A Partner Ecosystem from First Principles Identify, cultivate, and scale relationships with the partners who will amplify our reach. This isn't about managing existing relationships—it's about seeing what partnerships should exist and making them real. Greenhouse: Databricks:8788152002.location: Mountain View, California; San Francisco, California
Greenhouse: Databricks:8788152002.description: (GAQ427R221) Databricks is looking for a Revenue Accounting Manager to join our team. You will report to the Manager of Revenue Accounting and play a hands-on leadership role across the full revenue accounting close cycle, from evaluating complex contract terms and applying ASC 606, to leading UAT for new system logic, to preparing financial reporting deliverables for internal and external stakeholders. This is an individual contributor position with significant ownership and cross-functional influence. Our revenue accounting environment is evolving rapidly. New SKUs, new go-to-market motions, shifting policy requirements and system migrations are the norm. We need someone who thrives in ambiguity, adapts when priorities shift and takes ownership of complex problems. Our ideal candidate has a builder’s mindset: someone who digs into the details, challenges existing processes and leads improvements that make the close faster, more accurate and scalable. The Impact You Will Have Lead the close, end to end. Own and review monthly close activities, including usage reviews, journal entries, revenue estimates, flux analyses, account reconciliations and management reporting. Identify opportunities to improve quality and compress the close timeline. Apply ASC 606 with sound judgment. Evaluate complex and non-standard customer arrangements, document accounting conclusions and ensure consistent application of revenue recognition policies as our product portfolio evolves. Dig into the details. Pull, validate and troubleshoot data directly across contracts, billing systems, revenue systems and the general ledger. Trace discrepancies to the source and drive them through resolution. Own key revenue accounts. Manage revenue subledger-to-GL reconciliations for deferred revenue, contract assets and unbilled accounts receivable. Ensure balances are accurate, complete and supported. Turn data into insights. Analyze large datasets and explain key drivers affecting revenue, unbilled revenue, deferred revenue and other financial metrics. Provide clear recommendations to management. Lead system and process improvements. Define business requirements, lead UAT, assess accounting impacts and partner with Engineering and Finance Data Services to implement scalable solutions across revenue, billing and ERP systems. Automate relentlessly. Identify manual, repetitive processes and take ownership of building or championing automation through SQL, scripts, AI tools, workflow improvements or systematic solutions. Leverage AI to work smarter. Use AI tools and large language models to accelerate contract analysis, memo preparation, data reviews, reconciliations and process improvements. Strengthen internal controls. Execute and improve SOX controls, maintain clear documentation and ensure revenue processes comply with company policies. Support financial reporting. Prepare key metrics, financial statement disclosures, supporting schedules and ad hoc analyses for management. Support the audit with confidence. Prepare organized workpapers, respond to auditor requests, participate in walkthroughs and clearly explain the underlying transactions and accounting conclusions. Solve problems at the root. Lead investigations into revenue, process and system issues. Document conclusions and implement long-term solutions that reduce risk and prevent recurrence. Collaborate across functions. Build strong partnerships with Revenue Operations, Revenue Assurance, Deal Desk, Billing, Legal, Sales Operations, FP&A, Finance Data Services and Audit to address revenue-impacting matters. Raise the quality bar. Provide guidance to team members and improve the quality of close deliverables, documentation, controls and processes without direct people-management responsibilities. Greenhouse: Databricks:8604610002.description: Overview: The Sales Compensation Manager (L6) leads complex compensation operations workstreams that drive reliability, scalability, and risk reduction across the sales compensation function. You will own end-to-end commission administration for a large payee portfolio, ensuring flawless execution across payroll submissions, SOX compliance, exception management, and stakeholder delivery, operating at the frontier of what AI and modern tooling make possible so that automation is embedded by default, not bolted on. Operating with a 6–12 month horizon, you’ll independently scope and solve moderately complex problems, influence Directors and Sr. Directors, and raise the bar for the team through mentorship, enablement, and operational discipline with strong automation. The impact you will have: Own end-to-end sales compensation administration for a large payee portfolio with full accountability for accuracy, timeliness, SOX compliance, and high-quality execution across participant setup, plan distribution, calculation, payment readiness, and payroll submission. Lead payroll submission for one or more GEOs with 100% accuracy, timeliness, and SOX compliance, including zero-pay confirmations, audit checkpoints, and evidence completeness across controls. Proactively detect anomalies and apply conservative holds to prevent overpayment; operationalise Exception Committee items with traceable implementation and reduced exception cycle time, leveraging AI-powered anomaly detection and predictive payment risk scoring to identify issues before they reach payroll. Influence business partners across Sales Ops, Rev Ops, Payroll, HR, Legal, Accounting, Finance, etc. by framing decisions in terms of field experience, risk, and audit compliance, acting as the trusted first point of contact in escalation paths. Own and advance the team’s automation roadmap, driving adoption of AI across commission operations workflows, including intelligent anomaly detection, AI-assisted exception triage, automated evidence generation, and agentic validation of data across source systems, identifying where AI creates real leverage and building repeatable operating rhythms, standardized SOPs, and audit-ready documentation that improve quality, speed, and consistency while reducing execution risk. Enable the team through templates, playbooks, evidence packs, and exception trackers, mentoring analysts (including offshore resources) to raise execution quality beyond individual scope. What we look for: 10+ years of end-to-end sales compensation administration and commissions system operations, spanning payroll submissions, SOX control operations, exception modelling/recalcs, and stakeholder deliverables. Advanced proficiency with Xactly (administration, configuration, reporting, troubleshooting) and Excel/Google Workspace for complex modelling, analysis, and insight generation. Strong data validation skills across source-of-truth systems (SFDC, HRIS, Anaplan, etc.) with demonstrated ability to detect anomalies, perform complex commission modelling, and translate findings into clear recommendations. Understanding of SaaS go-to-market compensation models, including quotas, OTI, accelerators, overlays, SPIFFs, MBOs, and how plan mechanics influence seller behaviour. Experience deploying AI or automation solutions, whether through vendor tooling, custom workflows, or agentic systems, to measurably improve speed, accuracy, or coverage. Greenhouse: Databricks:8582993002.description: SLSQ327R270 The Sales Dev AI Programs Team works directly with Databricks' Sales Development and Sales leadership to architect the world's elite top-of-funnel engine, empowering every xDR and AE with the prospecting tools and programs to convert market potential into predictable revenue. We sit at the intersection of strategy, AI, and the field, and we own the programs that turn scaled, AI-native prospecting from an experiment into the operating standard. We are looking for a Sales Dev AI Program Manager to own outcomes and inspection, metric design, measurement and reporting, governance, benchmarking, enablement, content strategy, and change management for an AI-first prospecting program that touches the entire go-to-market organization. The Databricks IT organization is a product-led engineering team building intelligent, AI-powered platforms that simplify how work gets done across the company. For Finance, our vision is to eliminate manual, repetitive work by automating complex business processes, surfacing actionable insights, and orchestrating end-to-end workflows. We are reimagining finance operations so teams spend less time processing transactions, chasing approvals, and resolving exceptions, and more time delivering strategic insights that accelerate the business. We're looking for an SAP Functional SME to own the functional design of our core finance processes on S/4HANA and to shape how AI and agentic automation reimagine them. In this role, you'll be the deep functional authority for your domain—translating how the business actually runs into standard, clean-core S/4HANA solutions, using process intelligence to find what's broken, and defining where AI belongs in a controlled, auditable process . You'll work at the intersection of SAP and AI, bridging Finance and Engineering to deliver a simpler, smarter, more automated experience. The Opportunity SAP will serve as the foundation for Databricks' core finance processes, including Record-to-Report, Source-to-Pay, and Order-to-Cash. As the SAP Functional SME, you'll own the functional blueprint for those processes—leading discovery and AS-IS/TO-BE design, configuring S/4HANA, and defining the requirements for the intelligent, agentic layer that automates routine work and guides users through exceptions and approvals. You'll use process mining and business process intelligence to quantify opportunity and prioritize what to build, and you'll make the call on where AI-driven recommendations belong versus deterministic rules. Your mission is to combine deep functional expertise with the power of Databricks AI to create a modern, highly automated finance experience that lets the business scale. What You'll Do Own Functional Design: Lead end-to-end process discovery and AS-IS/TO-BE design for major finance processes (Record-to-Report, Source-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash), define S/4HANA solution scope, and design to standard, clean-core capabilities wherever possible. Configure S/4HANA: Own functional configuration, business rules, and master-data strategy for your domain, and partner with developers on extensions, APIs, and orchestration where standard functionality falls short. Drive Process Intelligence: Use process mining and business process intelligence (leveraging SAP Process Intelligence and related tools) to identify root causes, quantify opportunity, and prioritize improvements; translate those findings into concrete S/4HANA requirements. Shape the AI & Agentic Layer: Define the requirements for AI-assisted and agentic process improvements—task automation, intelligent recommendations, anomaly detection, and generative assistants—and make clear judgments about where AI belongs in a controlled, auditable process, where human-in-the-loop is required, and where a deterministic rule is the better answer. Bridge Business and Engineering: Serve as the connective tissue between Finance process owners and the engineering pods, partnering with architects and developers to embed AI safely and to define the data flows between S/4HANA, process intelligence tools, SAP BTP, and Databricks AI. Run Workshops and Validate Value: Facilitate stakeholder workshops to validate business value, define acceptance criteria, and lead user acceptance testing for both functional and AI features. Measure Outcomes: Define KPIs and track ROI for process improvements—cycle time, touchless transaction rate, exception and manual-touch reduction, adoption—and build the business cases for prioritized automation and AI initiatives. Enable Adoption: Coach and upskill process owners and functional teams on process intelligence, best practices, and AI adoption, and drive readiness and change management for what you ship. What You Bring 6+ years of SAP functional consulting experience , with hands-on delivery across at least one full S/4HANA lifecycle and deep expertise in one or more finance domains—Record-to-Report, Source-to-Pay, or Order-to-Cash—plus working fluency in adjacent areas and in master-data governance. Process Intelligence: Demonstrated experience leading process discovery, process mapping, and process mining using SAP Process Intelligence or equivalent BPI tools, and translating mining outputs into solution requirements. Clean-Core Mindset: Strong bias toward standard, clean-core S/4HANA design, with sound judgment about when a requirement genuinely warrants an extension versus a change in process. AI & Agentic Automation: Practical experience applying Databricks AI and agentic capabilities to enterprise processes, with strong judgment on where AI can drive automation and decision support while maintaining appropriate governance, controls, auditability, and human oversight. Integration Awareness: Solid understanding of integration patterns (APIs/OData, IDoc, SAP Integration Suite / BTP) and the data requirements that feed process mining and AI models. Governance Rigor: Working knowledge of SAP authorizations, SoD, SOX and audit requirements, and the ability to design processes and automation that satisfy them. Stakeholder Leadership: Excellent workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, and change-management skills, and the ability to present executive-level ROI and translate technical capability into measurable business value. Business-First Mindset: Pragmatic, outcome-driven approach to reducing process waste and risk, and comfort leading through ambiguity across complex business and IT landscapes. Preferred Qualifications SAP S/4HANA Associate or Professional certification for a relevant module, and SAP Activate methodology experience. Certification or training in SAP Process Intelligence, or experience with Celonis or other process mining vendors. Hands-on experience delivering at least one AI-assisted process improvement in production. Familiarity with the SAP AI and extension stack (BTP, AI Core, Joule) and a point of view on build-versus-adopt tradeoffs against a Databricks-native approach. Experience working alongside data teams to make ERP data usable for analytics and AI on modern data platforms (such as Databricks), and prior work in a high-growth technology company where ERP had to scale quickly. Greenhouse: Databricks:8679972002.description: GAQ126R43 About Databricks At Databricks, our mission is to help data teams solve the world's toughest problems—and that begins with empowering our own employees with exceptional internal products. The Databricks IT organization is a product-led engineering team building intelligent, AI-powered platforms that simplify how work gets done across the company. For Finance, our vision is to eliminate manual, repetitive work by automating complex business processes, surfacing actionable insights, and orchestrating end-to-end workflows. We are reimagining finance operations so teams spend less time processing transactions, chasing approvals, and resolving exceptions, and more time delivering strategic insights that accelerate the business. We're looking for an SAP Technical Lead to own the technical architecture and delivery of our SAP platform. In this role, you'll define the technical vision for a clean-core S/4HANA landscape, lead the engineers who build on it, and architect the intelligent, agentic AI layer that sits between SAP and the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. You'll set the standards, make the hard build-versus-adopt calls, and ensure everything we ship is secure, performant, and built to scale. The Opportunity SAP will serve as the foundation for Databricks' core finance processes, including Record-to-Report, Source-to-Pay, and Order-to-Cash. As the SAP Technical Lead, you will own how those processes are engineered—from the clean-core S/4HANA core and its extensions, to the integration fabric that connects SAP to the rest of the enterprise, to the AI and agentic services that make the experience intelligent. Rather than accumulating custom code inside the digital core, you'll champion a modern extensibility model on SAP BTP and the Databricks Lakehouse, so Finance teams get automated, AI-driven workflows on top of a core that stays clean, upgradable, and fast. Your mission is to combine the strength of SAP with the power of Databricks AI to build a technical foundation that lets the business scale. What You'll Do Own the Technical Architecture: Define and own the end-to-end technical architecture for the S/4HANA landscape (greenfield, brownfield, or selective data transition), aligned to clean-core principles, with clear guardrails that keep the digital core standard and upgrade-ready. Lead the Extensibility Strategy: Define and own the extensibility strategy for SAP, using Databricks-native applications to address business requirements beyond core SAP capabilities. Establish clear architecture and governance standards to ensure extensions are scalable, secure, and aligned with the broader Finance technology strategy. Drive Enterprise AI Integration: Drive a strong integration with ongoing Enterprise AI transformation within Databricks by bringing AI fluency and hands on AI experience. Design the Integration Fabric: Architect secure, resilient integration across SAP and non-SAP systems using SAP Integration Suite, event-driven patterns, APIs, OData v4, and change-data feeds into the Lakehouse, with clear contracts, error handling, and observability. Unify SAP Data in the Lakehouse: Partner with data engineering on the technical patterns for landing SAP data in Databricks—ingestion, CDC, semantic and master-data modeling, lineage, and governance. Set Engineering Standards: Establish CI/CD, automated testing, and transport/deployment pipelines for BTP artifacts; own code and design reviews; and define the technical standards, security patterns, and best practices the team builds against. Lead the Team: Mentor developers and architects, lead technical steering, and act as the connective tissue across the SAP ecosystem (BTP, Integration Suite) and the systems around it, partnering closely with functional, product, and partner engineering teams. Be Accountable for Non-Functionals: Own performance, scalability, security, resilience, and cost across the landscape; report technical status, risks, and roadmaps to stakeholders. What You Bring 10+ years in SAP technical roles , with 3+ years as a technical lead or architect, and a proven track record delivering at least one full S/4HANA program (greenfield or conversion) plus BTP-based extension delivery. Clean-Core Architecture: Deep, hands-on command of clean-core principles—custom-code assessment and remediation, in-app vs. side-by-side extensibility, released APIs and extension points, and the governance that keeps the core clean over time. SAP BTP & Modern Development: Advanced experience across SAP BTP, ABAP Cloud and the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP), CDS, and CAP, with Fiori/SAPUI5 on the front end. AI & Agentic Systems: Hands-on experience or strong technical command of agentic automation, LLM orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, and evaluation—plus clear judgment about where AI belongs in a controlled, auditable ERP process and where it does not. Integration & APIs: Advanced experience with SAP Integration Suite, API management, event-driven architecture, and REST/OData, integrating hybrid SAP and non-SAP landscapes. Data Fluency: Solid understanding of modern data platforms, SAP data extraction and modeling, pipelines, and semantic layers, and the practical work of making ERP data usable for analytics and AI. Governance Rigor: Working knowledge of SAP authorizations, SoD, SOX and audit requirements, and the ability to architect solutions and automation that satisfy them. Leadership: Ability to translate business requirements into technical architecture, present tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders, mentor engineers, and make pragmatic decisions that balance speed against long-term maintainability. Preferred Qualifications Experience building custom applications or automation layers on modern data platforms (such as Databricks) that extend or sit alongside SAP. A clear point of view on build-versus-adopt tradeoffs across the SAP AI and extension stack (BTP, AI Core, Joule) versus a Databricks-native approach. Hands-on knowledge of SAP integration surfaces and their limitations, including OData and REST APIs, CDS views, and Datasphere. Experience running Agile delivery with system integrators and managed service partners, including vendor and SLA accountability. SAP certification in SAP BTP, S/4HANA, or a relevant technology area, and prior work in a high-growth technology company where ERP had to scale quickly. Greenhouse: Databricks:8856932002.description: SLSQ427R662 Location: Open (United States) As a Scaled Engagement Manager at Databricks, you will be the operational engine of our high-growth Meetings at Events program. You will report to the Senior Director of Executive Engagement within the Sales Go-to-Market (SGTM) organization, and work alongside the Meetings Program Lead, who sets the overall strategy and executive motion. You'll own day-to-day execution across first- and third-party events, including meeting operations, reporting, enablement, and program documentation. This role offers an exciting opportunity to drive the day-to-day execution of a massive global program, partnering with operations contractors who will support you in executing tool builds, tracker upkeep, and venue logistics. If you thrive on organization, analytical reporting, and turning complex event needs into scalable execution, we want to hear from you! Key Responsibilities Meeting Operations & Event Execution Own meeting request intake, triage, approvals, scheduling, and real-time changes for Account Team-Led meetings, ensuring a smooth and consistent workflow. Oversee venue logistics and space planning, including room setup, signage, access, attendee tracking, and coordination with Marketing on food & beverage. Direct operations contractors supporting meeting tools, setup, go-live execution, QA, scheduling, and meeting-space/venue logistics. Provide on-site support at events globally, managing room flow, check-in, executive routing, scheduler coverage, and real-time conflicts. Step in to cover additional events alongside the Program Lead and operations contractors based on concurrent event volumes. Reporting, Analytics and Outcomes Own operational reporting across RainFocus, Jifflenow, AI/BI dashboards, SFDC campaigns, and other data sources. Turn complex data into actionable insights, deep-dive analysis, and leadership readouts. Direct the operations contractors on dashboard production, data QA, and survey assembly to ensure data integrity. Produce post-event recaps, surveys, and analytics that track performance against event and FY OKRs, partnering with Marketing Analytics on pipeline attribution and ROI reporting. Capture and reconcile meeting outcomes, including sales-team notes and post-event results. Enablement & Communications Own the creation, maintenance, and distribution of enablement materials (e.g., Know Before You Go guides, cheat sheets, best practices, calendar) for Sales, Marketing, and SGTM teams. Own program communications, drafting field updates and bi-weekly progress reports for the Program Lead’s review. Coordinate training sessions and office hours, serve as an escalation point for request approvals, and direct operations contractors in providing frontline event Slack support/Q&A. Program Management & Documentation Maintain and author the substance of the Meetings-at-Events Playbook, process documentation, and operating standards across first- and third-party events. Act as the dedicated project manager for the Data + AI Summit (DAIS) planning meeting workstream, owning meeting notes, updates, and follow-ups. Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, Sales, and Event Tech to coordinate logistics, surface risks/dependencies to the Program Lead, and translate lessons learned into improved workflows. Support quarterly event portfolio reviews and maintain event-tiering and third-party account-capture trackers. Required Qualifications 7+ years of meeting, event, or program coordination experience in a B2B enterprise software company. Experience coordinating event logistics, meeting space, vendors, and/or budgets. Greenhouse: Databricks:8194599002.description: CSQ426R319 Senior Customer Enablement AI Programs Manager As a Senior Customer Enablement AI Programs Manager, you will own the AI strategy and roadmap for the Scaled Customer Enablement Agent Suite — bringing together GTM activation, applied AI, and enablement strategy. You will define how the agents retrieve, reason over, and surface enablement insights to global Account Teams, turning learner and account data into prescriptive, just-in-time recommendations that improve account health and grow the number of trained users across our customer base. By automating GTM processes, you will ensure Account Teams and customers receive consistent Databricks enablement planning resources. You will be responsible for driving the AI roadmap for customer enablement, compounding enablement as a strategic leverage for our customers and for Databricks. This role will report to the Global Customer Enablement Practice Senior Director. This is an exciting opportunity for a motivated and innovative entrepreneur with a passion for working across departments and across regions. The impact you will have: Own the product roadmap and architecture direction for the Scaled Customer Enablement Agent Suite — defining the data inputs, retrieval sources, and agent behaviors that generate enablement recommendations. Lead the rollout and drive field adoption of the Scaled Customer Enablement Agent Suite, delivering automated learning insights and proposals to Account Teams. Structure the enablement knowledge base for retrieval — designing content schemas, metadata, and chunking so agents return accurate, grounded outputs — and maintain the underlying customer enablement playbook. Define the signals and triggers — usage patterns, learning milestones, and account-health thresholds — that prompt the agents to surface a free-to-paid enablement opportunity to Account Teams at the right moment. Partner with technical teams to embed enablement calls-to-action and insights directly into field tools. Define predictive signals and analytics that flag emerging account-health and skills gaps before they impact renewals or consumption, and integrate these into leadership reviews and manager coaching toolkits. Establish evaluation and quality loops for agent outputs — defining what “good” looks like, measuring accuracy and groundedness, and driving iteration with the technical team. What we look for 6+ years of experience in Sales Enablement, GTM Program Management, or Sales Operations in a high-growth SaaS environment. Proven track record of managing complex workstreams and delivering global field motions with measurable adoption. Hands-on fluency with modern AI systems — RAG pipelines, agents, and LLM-powered workflows. You understand how retrieval sources, prompt design, context and data hierarchies, and grounding affect output quality, and can translate that into requirements a technical team can build against. Demonstrated experience owning a product or system area end to end — defining requirements, collaborating with engineering and data teams, and shipping AI-powered capabilities from concept to field adoption. Comfort defining metrics and running experiments — instrumenting agent performance, measuring output quality and field adoption, and using analytics to drive iteration. Exceptional ability to work cross-functionally across Sales, Marketing, and Technical teams to ensure a unified enablement vision. Expert at using data dashboards to track progress and communicate the "business story" behind the numbers (e.g., the link between enabled users and consumption lift). Able to solve ambiguous problems in a fast-moving environment and translate complex strategies into simple, executable field instructions. Familiarity with the education technology or customer training landscape is a significant plus. Familiarity with how enablement and knowledge content must be structured for machine consumption (schemas, metadata, modularity) is a strong plus. Discover requirements for continuous monitoring to detect early performance issues, working with R&D and NOC teams to optimise the DNB customer environments. Build Rapid POCs, Test/Deploy/Monitor the solutions built by Databricks Engineering to address customer challenges and showcase advanced Spark/ML/AI runtime capabilities aligned with their business goals. Develop comprehensive playbooks and maintain a knowledge base of common issues and solutions for Spark, ML, and AI workflows. Train customer engineering and business teams on best practices in performance tuning, debugging, and effectively leveraging Databricks Features. Pilot new best practices processes/ programs, champion process improvements, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance the customer experience. Advocate for customers in business review meetings and maintain close relationships as a trusted advisor and primary technical point of contact. Collaborate onsite with Field Engineering, Sales, and Product teams during customer engagements and technical presentations to provide rapid solutions to production-impacting issues, demonstrating deep technical expertise and building strong customer trust. What We Look For: Technical Expertise in Big Data and Spark: 5 to 8 years of experience designing, building, and troubleshooting distributed computing applications, with 4+ years delivering production-scale Spark/ML/AI solutions using Python, Java, or Scala. Data Engineering Specialisation: Hands-on expertise with Data Lakes, SQL-based databases, and Cloud-based Data Warehousing/ETL tools like Snowflake, Redshift, Bigquery, etc Advanced Tech Skills : Deep knowledge of Spark core internals, Delta/Iceberg, JVM optimisation, and memory management, with additional proficiency in AI ecosystems like Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Generative AI. Advanced Proactive Problem Solving Skills : Proven ability to anticipate, identify, and mitigate risks while planning solutions for production challenges. Our most ambitious bet is Learning: making Databricks the place where anyone interested in data + AI comes to learn, and building the largest community of active, capable learners in the world. It's a long game with a simple thesis — if people learn data + AI on Databricks, it becomes ubiquitous with the field itself, driving adoption and revenue. You will report to the Senior Director, Finance Data, AI & Strategy, and serve as the domain and technical anchor for a team that turns financial operations into trusted, well-governed data and reporting. This individual is expected to be based in Bengaluru. This is a high-impact role at the intersection of finance and accounting domain expertise and modern BI/analytics capability. It is less about deep distributed-systems engineering, and more about deeply understanding how Finance and Accounting operate (close, reconciliations, revenue recognition, chart of accounts) and building a trusted data foundations on top of the Databricks platform and Finance DataLake that Finance and Accounting can rely on every day. behind every report Own and evolve the Finance semantic layer: metric definitions, business logic, and data models that ensure a single source of truth for financial reporting across Finance, Accounting, and the broader business Partner closely with Accounting during month-end and quarter-end close, providing hands-on support to ensure reporting data is accurate, timely, and reconciled, and driving timely resolution of data-related issues Build and maintain dashboards and reporting for monthly, quarterly, and executive-level reporting, translating financial data into decision-ready insight for Finance leadership and the CFO organization Identify, scope, and deliver AI use cases that materially change how Finance and Accounting work day to day, including forecasting automation, anomaly detection, and natural language interfaces (Genie Spaces) to financial data Build and maintain internal Finance applications (Databricks Apps, Genie Spaces, dashboards) that enable appropriate for financial data Partner with Accounting, FP&A, Internal Audit, and Procurement to deeply understand business and reporting requirements, and translate them into scalable semantic models and analytics products within the Finance DataLake Manage and grow a team of finance data analysts / finance engineers, setting standards for semantic modeling, dashboard design, and analytics delivery, reviewing work, and developing talent Enforce Git-based version control, change management, and CI/CD practices to satisfy SOX change management requirements for reporting and semantic layer changes Partner with IT and Engineering to provide requirements and perform UAT for new systems and processes affecting Finance data and reporting Establish data management, semantic modeling, and documentation standards and best practices for the Finance organization Serve as a proactive leader who regularly assesses Finance and Accounting pain points, aligns with cross-functional teams on organizational objectives, and holds the team accountable for high-quality, business-relevant results What We Look For: 12+ years of experience in business intelligence, financial analytics, or analytics engineering, with deep exposure to finance/accounting operations, and at least 3 years in a people management or team lead capacity Strong understanding of core finance and accounting concepts (month-end/quarter-end close, revenue recognition, intercompany, chart of accounts, and financial reporting) and the ability to translate them into semantic models and metrics Proficiency in Greenhouse: Databricks:8301830002.title: Senior Manager, Identity & Access Management (IAM)
Greenhouse: Databricks:8301830002.description: P-1494 Databricks is the Lakehouse company. More than 7,000 organizations worldwide — including Comcast, Condé Nast, H&M and over 50% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Lakehouse Platform to unify their data, analytics and AI. Databricks is headquartered in San Francisco, with offices around the globe. Founded by the original creators of Apache Spark™, Delta Lake and MLflow, Databricks is on a mission to help data teams solve the world’s toughest problems. To learn more, follow Databricks on Twitter, LinkedIn, andFacebook. For more information, visit www.databricks.com . About the Role We are looking for an experienced and forward-thinking Senior Manager of Identity & Access Management (IAM) to lead the teams responsible for building and operating our enterprise-wide identity, authentication, authorization, and access governance systems. This leader will own the strategy, architecture, and execution of IAM capabilities that support our employees, customers, and platform services at global scale. As the company grows, IAM is becoming a foundational pillar of our security posture and customer trust. You will ensure that our identity systems are secure, scalable, easy to use, and aligned with Zero Trust principles. This is a highly cross-functional leadership role partnering with engineering, security, IT, compliance, and product teams to deliver identity services that are reliable and secure by default. What You’ll Do Strategic Leadership Define the long-term IAM strategy, roadmap, and operating model across the enterprise and product ecosystem. Build scalable identity foundations that support global growth, cloud expansion, and evolving business needs. Establish best practices for identity lifecycle management, authentication, authorization, provisioning, and governance. Build and Lead High-Performing Teams Manage and grow IAM engineering and operations teams responsible for identity services, infrastructure, and tooling. Mentor technical leads and engineers; foster a high-performance and high-accountability culture. Develop effective team structures and prioritize workstreams aligned to business and security priorities. IAM Architecture & Engineering Lead the design and implementation of IAM capabilities including: Single Sign-On (SSO), MFA, and federated identity Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) Privileged Access Management (PAM) Identity lifecycle automation Directory services and identity stores Just-in-time access and least-privilege models Drive modernization of legacy systems and implementation of Zero Trust identity principles. Ensure scalability, high availability, and strong security controls across all identity platforms. Governance, Compliance & Risk Own identity governance programs including access reviews, audit readiness, onboarding/offboarding controls, and policy enforcement. Partner with compliance, risk, and legal teams to meet regulatory requirements (SOC2, ISO, FedRAMP, SOX, GDPR, etc.). Ensure operational rigor, strong documentation, and sustainable controls that withstand audits and customer expectations. Cross-Functional Partnership Work closely with IT, Product Security, Cloud Infrastructure, and Engineering to embed identity best practices throughout the organization. Collaborate with product teams to ensure customer-facing identity capabilities are secure, intuitive, and scalable. Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and serve as a trusted advisor on identity issues. What You Bring 8–12+ years of experience in security, identity engineering, or related technical fields Deep technical expertise in modern IAM technologies, directories, authentication protocols (SAML, OIDC, OAuth), and identity standards. Hands-on architecture or engineering experience within cloud environments (AWS/GCP/Azure). Experience implementing Zero Trust identity models and privileged access management frameworks. Strong understanding of identity governance, compliance requirements, and audit processes. Proven track record of leading high-performing teams and delivering complex, cross-functional programs. Excellent communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills. Why Join Us Lead and shape the future of the company’s identity strategy during a period of rapid growth. Work on highly impactful, company-defining initiatives that protect our people, platform, and customers. Solve complex IAM challenges across cloud, SaaS, and hybrid environments.
